Working Hours: 9:00 AM 6:00 PM (with flexibility for urgent requirements) Job Overview 
Revaz Capital is seeking a highly proactive, organised and versatile professional to take on the 
 dual responsibility of providing executive assistance to the Director while independently 
 managing the organisation's HR and administrative functions. 
 This position requires an individual who can efficiently manage the Director's professional 
 commitments, personal logistics and day-to-day requirements while ensuring smooth HR 
 operations, office administration and employee coordination. 
 The ideal candidate should possess excellent organisational skills, discretion, problem-solving 
 abilities and the confidence to handle multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced working 
 environment. The role requires flexibility and availability to manage urgent matters outside 
 regular working hours, including weekends and business travel, whenever necessary. 
Key Responsibilities 
 1. Human Resource Management 
 Independently manage end-to-end HR operations, including recruitment, candidate 
 screening, interviews, onboarding and employee offboarding. 
Maintain employee records, attendance, leave management and personnel 
documentation. 
 Handle employee queries, grievances, disciplinary matters and workplace concerns. 
 Manage probation reviews, confirmation processes, performance tracking and employee 
 appraisals. 
 Prepare HR letters, policies, internal announcements and employee communications. 
 Ensure timely completion of joining formalities, documentation and exit procedures. 
 Coordinate employee engagement activities and maintain a professional workplace 
 environment. 
 2. Office Administration & Operations 
 Take complete responsibility for the smooth day-to-day functioning of office operations. 
 Supervise housekeeping staff, ensuring cleanliness, hygiene and proper maintenance of 
 the office premises. 
 Prepare and monitor housekeeping staff schedules, duty allocations, attendance and 
 daily task completion. 
 Conduct regular inspections to ensure all workspaces, meeting rooms, washrooms and 
 common areas are maintained appropriately. 
 Monitor office supplies, pantry requirements, stationery and other administrative 
 essentials. 
 Coordinate with vendors, service providers and maintenance personnel. 
 Handle office expenses, administrative budgets, bills and vendor payments. 
 Ensure that office facilities and essential services are functioning efficiently. 
 3. Personal Assistant & Executive Support 
 Manage the Director's daily calendar, appointments, meetings and professional 
 commitments. 
 Plan, organise and prioritise the Director's daily schedule, ensuring timely reminders 
 and follow-ups. 
 Coordinate personal and professional appointments, meetings and engagements. 
 Manage incoming calls, emails and correspondence, prioritising important matters and 
 ensuring timely responses. 
 Act as the primary coordination point between the Director, employees, clients and 
 external stakeholders. 
 Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, briefing notes and necessary documents. 
 Attend meetings whenever required, record key discussions and ensure action points are 
 followed up. 
 Handle confidential information and sensitive matters with complete discretion. 
 Anticipate the Director's requirements and proactively manage tasks to ensure smooth 
 daily operations. 
 4. Travel & Logistics Management 
 Plan and coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements for the Director. 
 Manage flight bookings, hotel reservations, transportation, visa requirements and travel 
 documentation. 
 Prepare detailed travel itineraries and ensure all arrangements are confirmed in advance. 
 Coordinate last-minute travel changes and emergency arrangements whenever required. 
 Accompany the Director on business trips whenever necessary. 
 Ensure all travel-related logistics and documentation are managed efficiently. 
 5. Scheduling & Coordination 
 Maintain and monitor schedules for housekeeping staff and other office support 
 personnel. 
 Coordinate meeting schedules, appointments and daily work commitments. 
 Ensure timely follow-ups on tasks assigned by the Director. 
 Monitor pending activities and maintain a structured record of deadlines and 
 deliverables. 

 Coordinate with different departments to ensure smooth communication and timely 
 execution of responsibilities. 
 Candidate Profile & Qualifications 

 Experience: 6-8 years of relevant corporate experience in Executive Assistance, HR 
 Management, Office Administration or a combination of these functions.

 related field preferred.

 abilities.

 HRMS platforms.

 information responsibly.

 under pressure. 
 Flexibility: Willingness to manage urgent requirements beyond regular working hours 
 when necessary. 
 Mobility: Valid travel documents and willingness to travel domestically and 
 internationally at short notice, whenever required. 
 Personal Attributes

title: Human Resource Recruiter
description:
HR Recruiter & HR Operations Executive 
 Company: Vendiman Private Limited 
 Department: Human Resources 
 Designation: HR Recruiter & HR Operations Executive 
 Location: Andheri East, Mumbai 
 Work Mode: Work from Office 
 Experience: Minimum 1 year 
 Industry Preference: Retail, FMCG, Manufacturing, or related industries 
 Travel Requirement: Candidate must be willing to commute to the Andheri East office daily. 
 1. Job Summary 
 We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Recruiter & HR Operations Executive to manage end-to- 
 end recruitment and support essential HR operational activities. The role involves sourcing and hiring 
 candidates for blue-collar, white-collar, technical, and field operations positions, coordinating employee 
 onboarding and documentation, managing exit formalities, processing reimbursement claims, and maintaining 
 accurate HR records. 
 The ideal candidate should have at least one year of relevant experience, preferably in the Retail or FMCG 
 sector, with strong coordination, communication, follow-up, and Excel skills. 
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition 
 Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, including manpower requisitions, sourcing, screening, 
 interview coordination, offer management, and joining follow-ups. 
 Understand manpower requirements from department heads, operations managers, and project teams. 
 Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, employee referrals, recruitment consultants, 
 social media, walk-ins, and field networks. 
 Handle bulk hiring and lateral recruitment for field staff, operations, technical teams, sales, and 
 corporate positions across multiple locations. 
 Screen resumes, conduct initial HR interviews, and assess candidate suitability against job 
 requirements. 
 Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and maintain regular communication with candidates. 
 Negotiate salary within approved budgets and coordinate offer release and acceptance. 
 Follow up with selected candidates to minimize offer dropouts and ensure successful joining. 
 Meet defined recruitment turnaround times (TAT), preferably within seven days or as specified by the 
 hiring requirement. 
 Maintain an active candidate database and recruitment pipeline for current and future vacancies. 
 Prepare daily and weekly recruitment MIS covering open positions, sourcing, interviews, offers, 
 joining status, and pending requirements. 
 B. Employee Onboarding & Joining Formalities 
 Coordinate pre-joining communication and confirm the joining date with selected candidates. 
 Collect and verify employee joining documents, including: 

 Updated resume and photographs 
 Aadhaar and PAN details 
 Educational certificates and previous employment documents, as applicable 
 Bank account details and cancelled cheque, where required 
 Address proof and emergency contact details 
 UAN/PF and ESIC details, where applicable 
 Signed offer letter, appointment letter, and other required declarations 
 Prepare and maintain employee personal files and digital documentation. 
 Coordinate employee code creation, HRMS enrolment, and onboarding formalities with the concerned 
 teams. 

 Ensure offer letters, appointment letters, joining forms, and policy acknowledgements are completed 
 and filed. 
 Coordinate induction, introduction to company policies, and joining formalities. 
 Follow up on pending documents and ensure employee records are complete and accurate. 
 C. Employee Documentation & HR Records 
 Maintain updated employee master data, personal files, employment records, and document trackers. 
 Ensure employee documents are properly organized in physical and digital formats. 
 Track pending documents, employment confirmations, letters, and other HR records. 
 Prepare and issue standard HR letters, including employment certificates and other documents as 
 authorized. 
 
 Maintain confidentiality and ensure secure handling of employee personal and financial information. 
 Support HRMS data updates and maintain accurate employee records. 
 D. Employee Exit & Full and Final Documentation 

 Coordinate employee resignation formalities and maintain resignation records. 
 Collect resignation emails, acknowledgement records, and other required exit documents. 
 Coordinate exit clearance with reporting managers, IT, Administration, Finance, and other concerned 
 departments. 

 Track company assets, access cards, identification cards, and other assigned assets pending return. 
 Prepare and maintain exit checklists, exit interview records, and handover documentation. 
 Coordinate relieving letters, experience letters, and other separation documents as authorized. 
 Follow up with the concerned teams for Full and Final (F&F) settlement inputs and documentation. 
 Maintain an updated employee exit tracker with resignation dates, last working days, clearance status, 
 and pending formalities. 
 E. Employee Reimbursement Claim Processing 

 Receive and verify employee reimbursement claims and supporting bills or invoices. 
 Check claims against the applicable company reimbursement policy, approved limits, eligibility 
 criteria, and supporting documentation. 

 Identify missing bills, incomplete forms, duplicate claims, or discrepancies and follow up with 
 employees for corrections. 

 Maintain reimbursement trackers and employee-wise claim records. 
 Prepare reimbursement summaries and supporting documents for review and approval by authorized 
 personnel. 

 Coordinate with Finance and Payroll for approved claims and payment processing. 
 Maintain proper records of submitted, approved, rejected, and pending reimbursement claims. 
 Ensure reimbursement claims are processed within defined timelines and maintain confidentiality of 
 employee financial information. 
 F. HR Operations & Employee Coordination 

 Coordinate with employees and managers regarding HR documentation, onboarding, and exit 
 formalities. 

 Maintain trackers for recruitment, onboarding, employee documents, exits, and reimbursements. 
 Support employee engagement activities and other HR initiatives as required. 
 Assist in preparing HR reports, employee databases, and periodic management updates. 
 Ensure adherence to company HR policies and established procedures. 
 Perform other HR-related responsibilities assigned by the HR Manager or Head of HR. 
 3. Required Qualifications & Skills 

 Graduate or postgraduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related 
 discipline. 

 Minimum one year of relevant experience in recruitment and HR operations. 
 Prior experience in Retail or FMCG is preferred. 
 Exposure to bulk hiring, field recruitment, or multi-location recruitment will be an advantage. 
 Good knowledge of end-to-end recruitment and candidate management. 
 Basic understanding of onboarding, employee documentation, exit formalities, and reimbursement 
 processing. 

 Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and MS Office. 
 Experience with HRMS platforms will be an advantage. 
 Strong communication, coordination, negotiation, and follow-up skills. 
 Good organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities. 
 Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle employee records responsibly. 
 4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

 Timely closure of vacancies within the defined recruitment TAT. 
 Number of successful joinings against assigned hiring requirements. 
 Candidate offer acceptance and joining conversion rate. 
 Accuracy and timeliness of recruitment MIS and candidate trackers. 

 Completion of onboarding documentation within defined timelines. 
 Accuracy and completeness of employee files and HRMS records. 
 Timely completion of exit documentation and clearance follow-ups. 
 Accuracy and timely submission of reimbursement claims for approval. 
 Timely follow-up and closure of pending employee documentation. 
 5. Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be hands-on, organized, and comfortable handling both recruitment and routine HR 
 operations. The candidate must demonstrate strong follow-up skills, a service-oriented approach, attention to 
 detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced business environment. 
 Important: This is a full-time, work-from-office position at Andheri East, Mumbai. Candidates must be 
 comfortable with the daily commute and should have a genuine interest in building a career in recruitment and 
 HR operations.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Business Development Offline & Online Research 
 Identify and generate new business opportunities for traditional/offline market research, fieldwork services, and online sampling across India and international markets. Identify potential clients, including market research agencies, consulting firms, brands, corporate companies, and research partners. Promote Market Resonance's capabilities in qualitative research, quantitative research, fieldwork, mystery shopping, online research, and online sampling. Understand client requirements and identify opportunities to offer relevant research and sampling services. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients and business opportunities. Explore new markets, industries, and potential business segments to expand the company's client base. 
 2. Offline / Traditional Market Research Business Development 
 Generate new business opportunities for traditional market research and fieldwork projects. Identify opportunities for Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), In-Depth Interviews (IDIs), CATI, CAPI, Central Location Tests (CLTs), surveys, mystery shopping, and other research assignments. Connect with research agencies, brands, consulting firms, and other potential buyers of market research services. Understand client briefs, research objectives, target audiences, sample sizes, locations, methodologies, timelines, and budgets. Coordinate with internal project teams and fieldwork partners to check project feasibility and obtain costing. Prepare and share commercial quotations and proposals in coordination with the relevant teams. Follow up on submitted quotations and proposals to convert enquiries into confirmed projects. 
 3. Online Sampling Business Development 
 Identify and approach market research agencies, online research companies, panel providers, and other potential clients requiring online sample respondents. Generate business opportunities for online sampling projects across India and international markets. Understand online sampling requirements, including target audience, country, sample size, respondent profile, Length of Interview (LOI), Incidence Rate (IR), quotas, feasibility, and timelines. Coordinate with internal teams and sampling partners to check feasibility, availability, and pricing for different target audiences and markets. Prepare and share quotations for online sampling requirements. Follow up with clients on sampling enquiries, quotations, and proposals. Build long-term relationships with clients who require regular online sampling support. Identify opportunities to provide sampling solutions for general population, consumer, business-to-business (B2B), and other target audiences, depending on project feasibility. 
 4. Sales Follow-up & Business Conversion 
 Follow up with prospective and existing clients regarding enquiries, proposals, quotations, and ongoing business opportunities. Maintain regular communication with prospects throughout the sales process. Understand client concerns and coordinate with internal teams to provide suitable responses. Discuss pricing, commercials, and timelines in coordination with senior management. Work towards converting enquiries and qualified leads into confirmed projects. Maintain an updated sales pipeline and provide regular business development reports. Work towards achieving agreed business development and revenue targets. 
 5. Required Skills 
 Good understanding of business development, sales, and lead generation. Knowledge of market research, traditional/offline research, fieldwork, or online sampling would be an advantage. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to identify prospective clients and generate new business opportunities. Ability to understand client briefs, RFQs, research requirements, and sampling specifications. Good understanding of online sampling terms such as LOI, Incidence Rate (IR), sample size, quotas, feasibility, and CPI would be an advantage. Strong client relationship management and follow-up skills. Good negotiation, persuasion, and presentation skills. Ability to manage multiple leads, enquiries, quotations, and follow-ups simultaneously. Good commercial awareness and understanding of pricing and quotations. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Working knowledge of LinkedIn and other platforms for B2B prospecting would be an advantage. 
 Requirements: 
 Graduate in any discipline. Marketing, Business Administration, Management, or a related field would be preferred. 2-5 years of experience in business development, sales, client servicing, market research, online sampling, or a related field. Experience in B2B sales, lead generation, client acquisition, or research services would be an advantage. Experience dealing with market research agencies, brands, online panel companies, sampling providers, or fieldwork agencies would be preferred.

title: It Sales Business Development Manager
description:
About the role- We are hiring Senior Account Executive - Enterprise Technology Sales who have already proven they can hunt, qualify and close enterprise technology deals and who want to own a region, not just a quota. This is a new-business role reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, with an inside sales rep working for you.
 Locations: Pune, Mumbai
 What you'll do Build your own pipeline in your region outbound, OEM co-selling, events and your network and own the full cycle from discovery to closure. Sell enterprise AI, DevSecOps and observability and monitoring services, anchored on GitLab and leading AI platforms, to CTOs, CIOs and heads of engineering. Carry a gross-margin quota, forecast it accurately and protect pricing and payment terms. Be Fineshift's face to the OEM's regional field team: deal registration, joint account plans, co-selling. Lead an inside sales rep who books your first meetings. What you bring 5+ years in B2B technology sales in India, with a verifiable record of meeting quota we will ask for your last three years of numbers and reference-check them. You have closed enterprise or large mid-market deals of 25 lakh and above, in technology services, AI, DevOps, cloud, security, observability or data. You have built a territory from cold. You know what a week of outbound looks like, and you do not wait for leads. You can run a first meeting with a CTO on your own, and you are comfortable learning a technical product deeply. You understand margin, payment terms and risk, and you know when to walk away from a bad deal. You are proactive, accountable and results-driven: you set your own weekly targets, own your number without being chased, and measure yourself on closed business, not activity. You are looking for a role you can commit to and grow in for the next three to four years, not the next twelve months. Why Fineshift You own a region, with a path to running it. Each Senior AE opens a region South, West or North. Hit your number for 4 quarters and you become the Regional Sales Manager, building the team under you. We are not hiring for a seat on a large sales floor; we are hiring the people who will lead sales as we grow. Uncapped incentives on gross margin, with tiered multipliers. Your earnings go up as you cross tiers, and there is no ceiling. Our top performers earn well above their fixed pay. The plan is written down and shared with you before you sign. You sell what the market is buying right now. Enterprise AI, DevSecOps and observability are the three budget lines growing fastest in Indian enterprises. You will be selling on top of GitLab and leading AI platforms names that open doors. The OEM works your pipeline with you. As one of GitLab's largest partners in India, we get partner-sourced leads, co-selling and deal registration. You are not fighting the OEM's own team for accounts. A presales and delivery team that lets you promise what we deliver. Demos, POCs and solutioning are handled by our in-house technology team, so you sell with confidence and hand over cleanly. A short line to decisions. Pricing, terms and exceptions are decided by the CRO and the founder, usually the same day. No committee, no quarter-long approval cycle. A stable, bootstrapped company with no funding risk. Five years in, profitable, growing, no layoffs. We grow on margin, not on burn which means your incentives get paid.

title: Hr Executive And Generalist
description:
Job title: HR Executive Generalist Location: Greater Noida West (work from office) Experience: 25 years Employment type: Full-time, permanent Reports to: Management / Director 

 Role summary We're hiring a hands-on HR Generalist to run day-to-day HR to manage people across corporate, operations and warehouse teams. You'll handle the full employee lifecycle, from hiring to exit, and build processes that grow with the company. 
 Key responsibilities 
 Recruitment and onboarding 
 • Plan staffing needs with department heads and keep a monthly hiring plan. • Write job descriptions and post them on job portals, social media and through consultants. • Source, screen and shortlist candidates, and run telephonic and in-person interviews. • Coordinate interview rounds, collect feedback and keep a recruitment tracker. • Negotiate salaries, issue offer letters and follow up with candidates until they join. • Do background and reference checks, and verify documents. • Run induction: joining kit, policy briefing, team introductions and system access. • Manage and evaluate recruitment consultants and their billing. 
 Attendance, leave and time office 
 • Manage biometric attendance and check daily punch records. • Maintain leave records (CL, SL and EL), leave accrual, half-days, comp-offs and week-offs. • Track late entries, early exits, short hours and other exceptions, and follow up with employees. • Maintain shift schedules for operations and warehouse staff. • Close attendance every month and share the final data for payroll. 
 Payroll and compensation 
 • Prepare monthly payroll inputs: attendance, LOP, overtime, incentives, deductions, new joiners and exits. • Coordinate with accounts to process salaries on time and resolve salary queries. • Maintain salary structures and CTC breakups, and issue revision letters. • Handle advances and loans, and their recovery. • Collect investment declarations and proofs for TDS. 
 Statutory compliance 
 • Handle PF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, Bonus and Gratuity compliance. • Generate UANs, enrol employees in ESI, file monthly returns and process PF transfers and withdrawals. • Maintain the statutory registers and records required under the Shops & Establishments Act and other labour laws. • Coordinate with labour consultants and handle inspections and audits. • Track compliance for contract and agency staff. 
 Employee records and HR operations 
 • Keep personnel files complete and up to date, digital and physical. • Maintain the HRMS or HR trackers: employee master, headcount and organisation chart. • Issue letters: appointment, confirmation, transfer, promotion, warning, relieving and experience letters. • Track probation periods and complete confirmations on time. • Handle employee ID cards, assets, joining kits and access cards. • Keep employee personal data confidential, and get consent and undertakings signed where needed. 
 Policies and HR framework 
 • Draft, update and roll out HR policies: leave, attendance, code of conduct, travel, reimbursements, POSH and data privacy. • Prepare and maintain the employee handbook. • Make sure employees know the policies, and get policy acknowledgements signed. • Set up and run the POSH Internal Committee, its training and its records. 
 Performance management 
 • Run the annual and mid-year review cycles. • Help managers set KRAs and KPIs for each role. • Track review completion and consolidate ratings. • Process increments and promotions as per management decisions. 
 Employee engagement and relations 
 • Act as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievances. • Plan engagement activities, celebrations, festivals and town halls. • Run employee feedback and satisfaction surveys and follow up on the results. • Handle disciplinary matters: show-cause notices, inquiries and documentation. • Promote a respectful, inclusive and safe workplace. 
 Training and development 
 • Identify training needs with department heads. • Organise in-house and external training sessions. • Keep training records and gather effectiveness feedback. 
 Exit management 
 • Process resignations and track notice periods. • Conduct exit interviews and analyse the reasons people leave. • Coordinate no-dues clearance and asset recovery. • Complete full and final settlement on time. 
 HR MIS and reporting 
 • Prepare monthly HR MIS reports: headcount, joiners, exits, attrition, hiring status, attendance, overtime and leave trends. • Track hiring cost, time to hire and manpower cost by department. • Share insights and recommendations with management. 
 Administration support 
 • Support office administration where required: vendor coordination, housekeeping, security and facility upkeep. 
 Key performance indicators 
 • Time to fill open positions • Offer-to-joining ratio • Attendance and payroll accuracy, and on-time salary processing • Zero statutory compliance defaults or penalties • Employee attrition rate • Grievance resolution time • On-time completion of confirmations, appraisals and F&F settlements 
 Qualifications 
 • Graduate in any discipline. MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred. • 2–5 years of HR generalist experience, preferably in retail, apparel, e-commerce, warehousing or manufacturing. 
 Skills and knowledge 
 • Sound knowledge of Indian labour laws: PF, ESI, Shops & Establishments, Payment of Wages, Bonus, Gratuity and POSH. • Hands-on experience with end-to-end recruitment, including bulk and frontline hiring. • Strong in MS Excel or Google Sheets: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables and data cleanup. • Experience with biometric attendance systems and an HRMS or payroll software. • Good drafting skills for letters, policies and emails. • Fluent in English and Hindi. 
 Personal attributes 
 • Highly organised, detail-oriented and good with deadlines • Maintains strict confidentiality • Approachable and able to deal with people at every level, from warehouse staff to senior management • Takes ownership and works well in a fast-paced, growing company • Firm and fair in handling discipline and grievances 
 Working days: Monday to Saturday

Key Skills: Salary processing,Program,Bonus,PF,HR generalist activities,Leave,Engagement,Processing

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Human Resources (HR) Roles & Responsibilities Company Name: Banseog Technology India Pvt. Ltd.
 Department: Human Resources & Administration
 Designation: HR Executive / HR Manager
 Reporting To: Director / Management
 Location: Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Industry: Engineering & Manufacturing 1. Job Purpose To manage and oversee the complete Human Resources and Administration functions of the company, ensuring effective manpower management, employee satisfaction, statutory compliance, discipline, performance management, recruitment, payroll coordination, and smooth day-to-day office and factory operations. The HR department will act as a bridge between employees and management while maintaining a professional, transparent, productive, and stress-free working environment. 2. Roles & Responsibilities A. Recruitment & Selection Identify manpower requirements from all departments. Prepare and publish job descriptions for vacant positions. Source candidates through job portals, consultants, references, and other channels. Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews. Coordinate technical interviews with department heads. Negotiate salary packages within approved budgets. Issue offer letters and appointment letters. Complete joining formalities and induction processes. Maintain a recruitment database and hiring records. Ensure timely hiring as per company requirements. B. Joining & Employee Documentation Collect and verify employee documents. Maintain personal files of all employees. Prepare appointment letters, offer letters, confirmation letters, and employment agreements. Maintain employee master data. Issue employee ID cards. Maintain records of educational qualifications, experience, identity proof, and address proof. Ensure all joining formalities are completed before or on the date of joining. Explain company policies, rules, and regulations to new employees. C. Attendance & Leave Management Monitor daily employee attendance. Maintain attendance records for office and factory employees. Monitor late arrivals, early departures, absenteeism, and overtime. Maintain leave records and leave balances. Process leave applications as per company policy. Coordinate attendance corrections with department heads. Prepare monthly attendance statements for salary processing. Monitor weekly offs and holidays. Maintain proper records of shift attendance and overtime. D. Payroll & Salary Administration Coordinate monthly salary processing. Verify attendance, leaves, overtime, incentives, and deductions. Prepare monthly salary sheets. Coordinate salary disbursement with the Accounts Department. Maintain salary records and employee compensation details. Prepare salary slips. Calculate applicable statutory deductions such as PF, ESI, TDS, and professional tax, wherever applicable. Maintain records of salary revisions, increments, bonuses, and incentives. Ensure salaries are processed accurately and on time. Maintain confidentiality of employee salary information. E. Statutory Compliance & Labour Law Ensure compliance with applicable central and Uttar Pradesh labour laws. Maintain statutory registers and employment records. Coordinate PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, and other applicable statutory matters. Monitor minimum wages and applicable wage-related requirements. Coordinate factory licence and labour-related documentation with the concerned authorities. Ensure timely filing of applicable returns and statutory payments. Coordinate inspections, audits, and notices from government departments. Maintain records of contract labour, wherever applicable. Coordinate with consultants, legal advisors, and auditors. Keep management updated regarding changes in applicable labour laws. F. Performance Management & Employee Development Coordinate employee performance appraisals. Collect feedback from department heads. Monitor employee performance and productivity. Prepare performance improvement plans (PIP), wherever required. Coordinate employee training and development programmes. Identify skill gaps and training requirements. Maintain performance appraisal records. Coordinate confirmation, probation extension, promotion, and increment processes. Support management in employee development and career progression. G. Employee Relations & Grievance Handling Maintain healthy relationships between employees and management. Listen to employee concerns and resolve grievances professionally. Handle workplace conflicts and disciplinary matters. Conduct employee counselling when required. Maintain confidentiality in sensitive employee matters. Promote teamwork and a positive working environment. Encourage employee engagement and participation. Ensure fair and consistent implementation of company policies. Help maintain a respectful, safe, and stress-free workplace. H. Disciplinary Management Monitor employee discipline and workplace behaviour. Address repeated absenteeism, misconduct, negligence, and policy violations. Issue warning letters, show-cause notices, and other disciplinary communications as authorized. Maintain records of disciplinary actions. Coordinate performance-related warnings with department heads. Handle employee misconduct cases fairly and in accordance with applicable law. Ensure proper documentation before taking disciplinary action. I. Employee Separation & Exit Formalities Process employee resignations. Prepare resignation acceptance letters. Coordinate notice-period requirements. Conduct exit interviews. Prepare full and final settlement statements in coordination with Accounts. Calculate pending salary, leave encashment, deductions, and other applicable dues. Coordinate return of company assets, ID cards, tools, documents, and access credentials. Issue relieving letters and experience certificates after clearance. Maintain employee separation records. J. HR Policies & Documentation Develop, implement, and update HR policies. Prepare employee handbooks and HR manuals. Maintain policies regarding attendance, leave, overtime, holidays, increments, bonus, probation, confirmation, and disciplinary procedures. Prepare standard HR formats and documentation. Ensure policies are communicated to all employees. Maintain proper physical and digital HR records. Review policies periodically with management. K. Factory & Production HR Coordination Coordinate manpower requirements with Production, Design, Electrical, Assembly, Quality, Purchase, and other departments. Monitor factory workforce attendance and discipline. Ensure adequate manpower availability for production schedules. Coordinate employee shifts and overtime with department heads. Maintain records of machine operators, fitters, electricians, technicians, engineers, and other factory staff. Coordinate safety training and employee awareness programmes. Ensure employees follow workplace safety procedures. Support management in maintaining smooth factory operations. L. Administration & General Management Manage day-to-day office administration. Monitor housekeeping, cleanliness, and workplace maintenance. Coordinate office supplies, stationery, and other administrative requirements. Maintain records of company assets and employee ID cards. Coordinate transport, travel, accommodation, and visitor arrangements wherever required. Coordinate company events, celebrations, meetings, and employee engagement activities. Monitor office and factory facilities. Coordinate with vendors and service providers. Support management in administrative planning and execution. M. Training, Safety & Employee Welfare Organize employee induction and orientation. Coordinate technical and non-technical training. Maintain training attendance and feedback records. Coordinate fire safety and emergency awareness training. Support implementation of workplace health and safety practices. Monitor employee welfare facilities. Promote awareness of workplace hygiene and safety. Coordinate grievance redressal and applicable workplace committees. 3. Daily HR Responsibilities Check employee attendance and absenteeism. Monitor late arrivals and early departures. Coordinate manpower availability with department heads. Address employee queries and grievances. Follow up on recruitment and interviews. Complete joining and exit formalities. Monitor office and factory discipline. Coordinate administrative requirements. Update HR records and employee documentation. Report important HR matters to management. 4. Weekly HR Responsibilities Review department-wise manpower requirements. Review pending recruitment and interview status. Check attendance irregularities and absenteeism. Review employee performance concerns with department heads. Follow up on pending employee documentation. Review administrative and maintenance requirements. Discuss employee grievances and disciplinary issues. Submit a weekly HR activity report to management. 5. Monthly HR Responsibilities Finalize attendance and leave records. Prepare and verify monthly payroll inputs. Coordinate salary processing. Prepare department-wise manpower reports. Review overtime and employee absenteeism. Update employee master data. Review recruitment and employee turnover reports. Monitor PF, ESI, and other applicable compliance requirements. Prepare monthly HR and administration reports. Review employee performance and training requirements. Submit pending HR issues and recommendations to management. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely completion of recruitment. Employee attendance and punctuality. Payroll accuracy and timely processing. Statutory compliance within applicable deadlines. Employee retention and reduced attrition. Timely completion of joining and exit formalities. Proper maintenance of employee records. Effective grievance resolution. Timely submission of HR reports. Reduction in unnecessary overtime and manpower shortages. Improvement in employee discipline and productivity. Effective coordination with all departments. 7. Required Qualifications & Skills Educational Qualification: MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management preferred. Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Knowledge of labour laws and HR administration. Experience: 2–5 years of relevant HR experience preferred. Experience in engineering or manufacturing industries will be an advantage. Technical Skills: Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and email communication. Knowledge of payroll and attendance management. Understanding of PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, and labour law compliance. Experience in HR documentation and employee record management. Professional Skills: Good communication and interpersonal skills. Problem-solving and decision-making ability. Strong organizational and coordination skills. Confidentiality and professional ethics. Ability to handle employee issues tactfully. Time management and multitasking. Ability to coordinate with senior management and factory employees. 8. Authority & Reporting Responsibilities The HR department is authorized, within management-approved policies and delegations, to: Coordinate recruitment and interview processes. Maintain employee attendance and leave records. Communicate HR policies and procedures. Issue routine HR communications. Recommend disciplinary action where required. Recommend salary increments and employee benefits. Coordinate employee training and development. Report serious employee-related matters to management. All major decisions relating to hiring approvals, salary revisions, termination, policy changes, and disciplinary actions shall require approval from authorized management. 9. Expected Outcomes Smooth functioning of HR and administration activities. Proper manpower planning and utilization. Improved employee discipline and accountability. Timely salary processing and statutory compliance. Better communication between employees and management. Reduced employee grievances and workplace conflicts. A professional, organized, productive, and positive work environment. Note: The HR department is responsible for maintaining transparency, confidentiality, fairness, and consistency in all employee-related matters.

title: Hr Management Executive
description:
Department: Human Resources
 Experience: 2-5 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: Sector 46 Gurugram
 Role: HR Manager 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a proactive, result-oriented, and hands-on HR Manager who can take end-to-end ownership of the company's human resource management function. 
 The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding manpower requirements and preparing job descriptions to candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, documentation, background verification, and successful onboarding. 
 Beyond recruitment, the candidate will be responsible for developing structured HR processes, improving people management practices, optimizing resource allocation, and building a strong organizational culture that supports the company's growth. 
 We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage HR activities but takes ownership of building and strengthening the company's people and resource management ecosystem. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 1. End-to-End Recruitment & Talent Acquisitio n 
 Take complete ownership of the recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements to final candidate onboarding. Coordinate with department heads, team leaders, and management to understand manpower requirements, business objectives, and hiring priorities. Understand the KRAs, KPIs, responsibilities, and performance expectations associated with every position. Create clear, detailed, and result-oriented Job Descriptions (JDs) for different roles. Source relevant candidates through Naukri.com, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms. Independently manage recruitment dashboards, job postings, candidate databases, and applicant tracking. Shortlist candidates based on experience, skills, qualifications, attitude, and suitability for the role. Conduct initial HR screening and scrutinize candidates thoroughly before forwarding them to the relevant stakeholders. Schedule and coordinate interviews with department heads, management, and other relevant stakeholders. Ensure timely follow-ups, feedback collection, salary negotiations, and offer rollouts. Maintain a strong candidate pipeline to ensure quick turnaround time for open positions. Develop effective recruitment strategies to minimize hiring time without compromising on candidate quality. 
 2. Candidate Evaluation & Performance Alignment 
 Understand the company's expectations and the targets associated with each role. Evaluate candidates not just on their qualifications but also on their ability to deliver expected business outcomes. Assess communication skills, problem-solving abilities, professional attitude, cultural fit, and role-specific competencies. Develop structured screening formats, interview evaluation sheets, and candidate assessment frameworks. Ensure that the right candidates are selected for the right roles. 
 3. Employee Onboarding & Documentation 
 Take complete responsibility for the joining and onboarding process. Ensure all joining formalities and employee documentation are completed accurately and on time. Manage offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements, NDA documents, policy acknowledgements, and other HR documentation. Coordinate background verification (BGV), reference checks, and employment verification. Ensure proper employee data management and maintain organized employee records. Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure employees have the necessary resources, access, and information when they join. Design a structured employee induction and orientation process. 
 4. HR Process Development & Implementation 
 Develop, implement, and continuously improve HR policies, SOPs, workflows, and processes. Establish structured processes for recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, performance management, and employee exits. Create standardized HR documentation, formats, checklists, and reporting mechanisms. Build systems that improve accountability, transparency, efficiency, and overall people management. Identify gaps in existing HR processes and proactively implement improvements. Ensure HR practices are aligned with the company's business objectives and growth plans. 
 5. Resource Planning & Manpower Management 
 Understand the manpower requirements of different departments. Coordinate with department heads to forecast current and future hiring needs. Maintain a clear understanding of employee strength, available resources, vacancies, and resource utilization. Help management optimize manpower allocation based on business priorities. Monitor hiring requirements against organizational targets and operational needs. Maintain updated manpower planning and recruitment dashboards. 
 6. HR Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics 
 Maintain and regularly update recruitment dashboards on Naukri.com, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other hiring platforms. Track recruitment metrics such as: Number of open positions. Candidates sourced and shortlisted. Interviews scheduled and conducted. Selection and offer acceptance ratios. Joining ratios and recruitment turnaround time. Cost and effectiveness of hiring channels. Prepare periodic HR and recruitment reports for management. Maintain employee databases, attendance records, leave records, and other relevant HR MIS. Use data and analytics to identify recruitment bottlenecks and improve HR efficiency. 
 7. Employee Management & Engagement 
 Act as a bridge between employees, department heads, and management. Address employee concerns, grievances, and workplace challenges. Develop initiatives that improve employee engagement, motivation, retention, and productivity. Help establish a professional, accountable, and performance-driven work culture. Support performance appraisal processes and employee feedback mechanisms. Ensure employees understand their roles, responsibilities, targets, and organizational expectations. 
 8. HR Compliance & Employee Lifecycle Management 
 Ensure proper maintenance of employee records and statutory HR documentation. Coordinate payroll inputs, attendance, leave management, and employee-related records. Support compliance with applicable employment laws and statutory requirements. Manage employee exit formalities, exit interviews, clearance processes, and full-and-final coordination. Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of employee information. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 2-5 years of hands-on experience in Human Resource Management, preferably in a growing or fast-paced organization. Strong expertise in end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition. Hands-on experience with Naukri.com, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other recruitment portals. Ability to independently source, screen, evaluate, and close candidates quickly. Excellent understanding of Job Description creation, KRAs, KPIs, and manpower planning. Strong knowledge of employee onboarding, documentation, and background verification. Experience in creating HR policies, SOPs, and structured HR processes. Good command of Excel, Google Sheets, HR MIS, and recruitment dashboards. Excellent communication, coordination, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational abilities and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously. A proactive, problem-solving, and ownership-driven approach. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 The performance of the HR Manager will be measured on the following parameters: Recruitment Turnaround Time: Ability to close open positions within defined timelines. Quality of Hiring: Relevance, competency, and suitability of candidates hired. Interview Conversion Ratio: Effectiveness of candidate sourcing and shortlisting. Joining Ratio: Percentage of selected candidates who successfully join. Onboarding Efficiency: Timely completion of joining formalities and documentation. BGV Completion: Timely and accurate completion of background verification. Process Development: Successful implementation of HR policies, SOPs, and workflows. Manpower Planning: Effective resource allocation and fulfillment of departmental requirements. Employee Retention: Contribution toward employee satisfaction and retention. HR Reporting: Accuracy and timely submission of recruitment and HR dashboards. 
 The Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is: 
 A self-driven professional who can independently manage the complete HR function. Quick, organized, and efficient in closing multiple job positions. Strong at understanding business requirements and translating them into effective hiring strategies. Comfortable coordinating with senior management and different departmental stakeholders. Process-oriented and capable of building HR systems from scratch. Data-driven and comfortable working with recruitment dashboards and reports. Someone who takes ownership, delivers results, and believes in building a strong team for organizational growth. 
 Most importantly, we need an HR professional who can help the company grow by ensuring that the right people are hired, the right resources are deployed, and the right people management systems are in place. 
 What We Expect 
 This is not a purely administrative HR role. We expect the selected candidate to be a hands-on HR leader who can drive recruitment aggressively, streamline people management, establish scalable HR processes, and contribute directly to the company's overall growth. If you are someone who can take complete ownership of HR operations, hire the right talent quickly, and build a strong and efficient workforce, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
Senior Sales Manager O2Cure | Delhi NCR | Full time, in office 
 Reports to Kartik Singhal, Founder Experience 5 to 7+ years selling HVAC, air purification or allied building services in India Compensation 15 lpa to 20 lpa Apply to jobs@oxycure.in 
 Most sales roles hand you a territory inside somebody else's category. This one hands you the category. 
 India is only beginning to buy clean air the way it already buys clean water. Who ends up owning that shift is still an open question, and we intend to be part of the answer. We are looking for the person who will set a number nobody asked them for, and then go and hit it. 
 The Company OXYCURE designs and manufactures air and environment products in India. O2Cure is our air purification line for homes, offices, hospitals, hotels and industrial spaces. Moscure is our chemical-free mosquito control range. 
 The Role 
 You are the sales engine for O2Cure. Not a coordinator, and not a team lead waiting for a team. You carry the number personally, you open the doors yourself, and you close. You also walk in with something most people joining a company this size do not get. There is a mapped NCR pipeline of more than 350 qualified prospects across hospitals, hotels, banquets, farms and commercial spaces, already visited and segmented. It is warm and it is waiting. What it has been missing is someone who will work it properly. 
 What You Will Own 
 - The number. Set the target, own the forecast, defend both. We would rather you set a goal post higher than we would have asked for and fall slightly short than watch you clear something safe. - Your book. Bring the relationships you already have across facility heads, hospital infrastructure teams, hotel engineering, MEP consultants, architects and dealers. Open doors in week one, not month six. - The close. First meeting to signed order. Proposal, pricing conversation, objections, follow-through. Nothing handed off at the last mile. - The demo standard. A demo that lands is the difference between a signed order and a polite no. Set the protocol, decide placement and timing, and hold the team to it. - Channel. Build and run the dealer and partner network across NCR first, then beyond it. - The funnel, honestly. Keep it clean and report your own numbers straight, including the bad weeks. 
 Who We Are Looking For - 5 to 7+ years selling HVAC, air conditioning, air purification, indoor air quality, building automation or allied building services in India. - A live network, not a historic one. You should be able to name twenty people you could call this week who would take the call. - Technical enough to hold a conversation with a facility engineer without reaching for backup. - Exceptional communication in English and Hindi. - Clear on a call, clear in a room, clear in writing. - Someone who has personally closed, not someone who has managed people who closed. - Delhi NCR based, in office, willing to travel for client meetings. 
 Why This And Not Your Current Job - A category to own rather than a territory to service. - Pricing, discounts and deal structure get answered the same week, not the same quarter. - A team under you as the number grows.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist(IT and NON IT)
description:
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior IT & Non-IT Recruiter with a minimum of 3+ years of experience in end-to-end recruitment. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing candidates across IT and Non-IT domains. The candidate should be capable of handling multiple requirements simultaneously, coordinating with hiring managers, and ensuring timely closures while maintaining a positive candidate experience. Key Responsibilities Handle end-to-end recruitment for IT and Non-IT positions. Understand job requirements and coordinate with hiring managers to identify hiring needs. Source candidates through job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms. Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews to assess candidates' skills, experience, and suitability. Handle recruitment for various IT positions, including: Software Developers Java / .NET Developers Python Developers Full Stack Developers QA / Automation Testers DevOps Engineers Data Analysts IT Support and Networking Professionals Handle Non-IT recruitment for positions such as: Sales & Marketing HR & Administration Accounts & Finance Operations Customer Support Business Development Back Office & Management roles Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates and hiring managers. Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process until joining. Negotiate salary packages and manage offer rollouts. Maintain candidate databases, recruitment trackers, and daily/weekly MIS reports. Ensure timely closure of open positions within defined turnaround times. Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future requirements. Required Skills & Qualifications Minimum 3+ years of experience in IT and Non-IT recruitment. Strong knowledge of end-to-end recruitment processes. Hands-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other job portals. Excellent candidate sourcing and screening skills. Good understanding of technical and non-technical job requirements. Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to handle multiple requirements and work under deadlines. Good coordination and follow-up skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and recruitment MIS reporting. Preferred Candidate Profile Experience in handling bulk and lateral hiring. Experience in working on multiple client requirements. Strong candidate networking and talent-pooling capabilities. Target-oriented and self-motivated individual. Ability to work independently and achieve recruitment targets. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Number of positions closed per month. Quality of candidates shortlisted. Interview-to-selection ratio. Offer-to-joining ratio. Time-to-fill open positions. Candidate engagement and follow-up efficiency.

title: Recruiter Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Temporary Recruitment Specialist One Month Contract Company: Stocktally
 Location: Pune
 Engagement Period: 1 Month (Temporary / Contractual)
 Position Type: Full-time / Temporary About Stocktally Stocktally is a Government of India-recognized startup specializing in Inventory Audits, Stocktaking, Physical Verification, Asset Verification and Inventory Intelligence solutions. We serve clients across Automobile, Retail, Pharmaceutical, Manufacturing and Warehousing sectors across India. Job Overview Stocktally is looking for a proactive and result-oriented Recruitment Specialist for a temporary period of one month. The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying, sourcing, screening and recruiting candidates for various positions within the organization. The candidate must be capable of handling multiple vacancies simultaneously and completing the recruitment process within tight timelines. Key Responsibilities Understand the manpower requirements and job profiles from the management. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Apna, WhatsApp groups, employee references and other recruitment channels. Identify suitable candidates for Sales, Operations, Audit Assistants, Supervisors and other assigned positions. Screen resumes and conduct preliminary telephonic interviews. Evaluate candidates based on qualifications, experience, communication skills and job suitability. Coordinate interviews with department heads and management. Maintain regular follow-ups with shortlisted and selected candidates. Negotiate salary expectations and communicate employment terms. Ensure selected candidates complete documentation and join within the stipulated timeline. Maintain a recruitment database and submit daily recruitment progress reports. Build a pipeline of suitable candidates for future requirements wherever possible. Desired Skills & Qualifications Graduate in any discipline; HR or Business Management qualification preferred. 1–4 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition. Good understanding of job portals and online recruitment platforms. Excellent communication and candidate-handling skills. Ability to source candidates quickly and independently. Good coordination, follow-up and negotiation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and basic computer applications. Ability to work with multiple vacancies and tight deadlines. Key Deliverables During the One-Month Assignment Complete recruitment cycle management for assigned vacancies. Consistent sourcing and screening of suitable candidates. Regular interview scheduling and coordination. Timely closure of assigned positions. Ensuring selected candidates actually join Stocktally. Daily recruitment MIS covering candidates sourced, screened, interviewed, selected and joined. Performance Evaluation The Recruitment Specialist will be evaluated on: Number of suitable candidates sourced. Quality of shortlisted candidates. Number of interviews coordinated. Number of positions successfully closed. Candidate joining ratio. Speed and efficiency of recruitment. Accuracy of recruitment documentation and reporting. Who Should Apply? We are looking for someone who is energetic, resourceful, target-oriented and capable of getting things done independently. If you enjoy finding the right people, connecting with candidates and closing vacancies within deadlines, this opportunity is for you. Apply now to work with Stocktally for an exciting one-month recruitment assignment!

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing sales opportunities. Willingness to travel extensively to meet with potential subscribers and attend industry events as needed. Familiarity with scholarly publishing history, trends, and nuances is highly desirable. Benefits: 
 Competitive salary and commission structure. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Join IndianJournals.com and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact on academic research and education in India. Apply now to embark on an exciting career in scholarly publishing sales!

title: After Market Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 The Parts Wholesale Manager (Aftermarket Parts Manager) is responsible for driving the growth of Ford parts sales across multiple IMG (International Markets Group) markets. This individual will strategically build and expand the sales channels for Ford parts, encompassing Ford dealers, Ford Authorized Distributors, independent parts wholesalers, garages, fleet customers, and Professional Service Network (Trade Club) members. A key aspect of this role involves assisting IMG markets in optimizing their route-to-market strategies and enhancing existing market sales through targeted demand creation initiatives and promotional campaigns. Furthermore, the Parts Wholesale Manager will play a crucial role in developing robust reporting mechanisms, securing necessary program resources, and designing effective incentive programs aimed at significantly increasing Ford Parts sales for both Ford and multi-make vehicles. Responsibilities 
 Strategic Sales Growth: Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to increase Ford parts wholesale (Over The Counter - OTC) sales volume and market share across all designated IMG markets balancing overall profitability. Market Development & Optimization: Analyze existing market conditions, sales performance, understand competitors and route-to-market effectiveness in each IMG market. Provide expert guidance and support to IMG market teams on best practices for parts distribution, inventory management, marketing and sales execution. Assist in the development and implementation of tailored route-to-market strategies that align with regional / local nuances and business objectives. Demand Creation & Campaigns: Lead the planning and execution of demand creation activities, marketing campaigns, and promotional programs to stimulate Ford parts sales together with IMG market teams. Work with local marketing teams to ensure effective communication of product value propositions and benefits to various customer segments. Monitor campaign performance and provide insights for continuous improvement. Program Development & Support: Support IMG market teams to design and implement incentive programs and sales initiatives to motivate and reward strong performance among sales channels and customers. Identify and secure necessary program resources, including marketing materials, training, and technical support, to aid sales efforts at regional level. Collaborate with product teams to understand new parts' offerings, provide input for emerging product opportunities and integrate them into sales strategies for both Ford and multi-make applications. Collaborate with Motorcraft team to ensure Motorcraft product usage is maximized in the OTC channel, improving competitiveness. Assist and support the structure of Certified Wholesale Parts Dealers/Distributor (CPWD) program as well as design performance standards and track them. Seeking E-commerce opportunity for B2C business, establish the channel where possible. Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Develop and maintain robust reporting frameworks and key performance indicators (KPIs) to track parts sales performance and monthly forecast across IMG markets. Conduct regular analysis of sales data, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and challenges. Prepare and present detailed sales forecasts, performance reviews, and strategic recommendations to senior management. Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key stakeholders, including IMG market leadership, Ford dealers, Ford Authorized Distributors, and major independent customers. Act as a primary point of contact for parts wholesale inquiries and support needs within the assigned region. Training & Development: Provide training and ongoing support to regional sales teams and channel partners on Ford parts product knowledge, sales techniques, and program specifics. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing regarding aftermarket parts sales best practices. Manage and develop regional and market team members who work on this business. 

 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in business administration, Marketing, Automotive Management, or a related field. A master's degree or relevant professional certifications are a plus. Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in automotive aftermarket parts sales, distribution, or wholesale management, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets. Prior experience in a regional or multi-market role, particularly within international markets, is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience in developing and executing sales strategies for parts. Experience working with dealer networks, independent wholesalers, and fleet customers.

description:
Role & responsibilities : - 1. Visual Merchandising (VM) Develop and implement visual merchandising strategies aligned with Carrefours brand guidelines, business priorities, and seasonal plans. Plan and execute store layouts, product displays, promotional zones, signage, and in-store communication to improve product visibility and customer experience. Ensure consistent implementation of VM standards across stores through regular visits, audits, and corrective action plans. Create VM guidelines, display manuals, seasonal plans, and execution standards for store teams. Work with category, commercial, and store operations teams to maximise the impact of product presentation and promotional displays. 2. Offline Marketing & Campaign Management Plan and execute offline marketing campaigns to drive store footfall, customer engagement, and sales. Manage seasonal, festive, promotional, product-launch, and store-level campaigns and activations. Develop and execute in-store branding and communication materials, including standees, danglers, posters, banners, and promotional displays. Plan local store marketing initiatives based on catchment requirements and business priorities. Ensure campaigns are implemented across stores within approved timelines and in line with brand guidelines. Monitor campaign execution and assess effectiveness through relevant performance indicators. 3. Vendor & Agency Management Identify, onboard, and manage vendors, agencies, printers, fabricators, and other external partners. Coordinate production, delivery, installation, and quality checks for VM and marketing materials. Negotiate commercial terms, review quotations, and monitor vendor performance against agreed timelines and standards. Resolve execution issues and ensure adherence to agreed service levels and commitments. 4. Budgeting & Cost Management Prepare and manage annual, monthly, and campaign-wise VM and offline marketing budgets. Track expenditure against approved budgets and ensure effective utilisation of allocated resources. Identify cost-saving opportunities through vendor negotiations and efficient campaign planning. Maintain accurate records of marketing spends, purchase orders, invoices, and campaign expenses. 5. Store Coordination & On-ground Execution Work closely with Store Managers, Department Managers, and store operations teams to ensure seamless execution. Spend significant time at stores to personally monitor VM standards, campaign roll-outs, branding, and promotional visibility. Conduct regular store visits and execution audits; identify gaps and drive timely corrective action. Brief store teams on campaign requirements and ensure all necessary materials are available before launch. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve store-level execution challenges. 6. Reporting & Performance Monitoring Maintain campaign calendars, VM implementation trackers, store audit reports, and vendor performance records. Track execution timelines, campaign compliance, budget utilisation, and quality standards. Share periodic progress reports and updates with the reporting manager and senior management. Recommend improvements based on store observations, campaign outcomes, and customer response. 
 Preferred candidate profile: - Graduate degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Visual Communication, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is an advantage. 610 years of relevant experience in visual merchandising, retail marketing, or offline marketing, preferably in organised retail, supermarkets, hypermarkets, or large-format retail. Demonstrated experience managing multi-store VM execution, offline campaigns, vendor relationships, and marketing budgets. Strong understanding of retail branding, in-store communication, display planning, and promotional execution Key Competencies 
 Strong execution orientation, visual sensibility, and attention to detail. Project management, planning, and multi-stakeholder coordination. Commercial acumen, negotiation, and budget management. Strong communication and relationship-management skills. Proactive problem-solving ability and a hands-on approach. Flexibility to travel frequently and work closely with store teams. 
 Role Expectation 
 This is a corporate-based position with a substantial field-execution requirement. The incumbent is expected to spend considerable time visiting stores and personally driving the implementation of visual merchandising and offline marketing initiatives. Success will be measured not only by the quality of planning and creative concepts, but also by the consistency and excellence of their execution at store level.

title: Accounts Reconciliation
description:
Account Reconciliation Analyst / Senior Analyst 
 
 The Role 
The Account Reconciliation Analyst is responsible for analyzing, reconciling, and driving resolution of GR/IR, Trade, Leasing, Consignment, and other clearing or control account balances. The role focuses on reducing aged open items through detailed investigation, root-cause analysis, and coordination of corrective actions across Procurement, Accounts Payable, Logistics, Receiving, and Finance teams. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Open-Item Analysis & Resolution 
 Perform detailed analysis of GR/IR, Trade, Leasing, Consignment, and other clearing or control account balances. Review aged open items, unresolved balances, and recurring exceptions requiring investigation and action. Investigate discrepancies across purchase orders, goods receipts, supplier invoices, delivery documents, approvals, and accounting postings. Identify root causes of outstanding balances, draw conclusions, and define corrective actions with the appropriate stakeholders. Drive resolution of aged, complex, and unclear ownership items through effective follow-up, stakeholder engagement, and escalation where necessary. Ensure outstanding items are properly explained, documented, and resolved to support balance sheet integrity and prevent recurrence. 
 Account Reconciliation & Financial Close Support 
 Prepare and perform balance sheet reconciliations for assigned accounts in accordance with company policies and financial controls. Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities for assigned reconciliation areas. Validate account balances, investigate variances, interpret open items, and provide clear supporting documentation. Ensure reconciliation activities are completed accurately, on time, and with appropriate evidence for review and control purposes. Maintain reconciliation records and analysis to support internal and external audit requirements. Root Cause Analysis & Process Improvement 
 Analyze recurring reconciliation issues and identify process weaknesses across Accounts Payable flows. Recommend corrective actions to reduce aged balances, blocked invoices, clearing differences, and recurring open items. Work with Procurement, AP Operations, Logistics, Receiving, Business users, and Finance teams to improve data quality, process compliance, and transaction accuracy. Support standardization, reporting improvements, and continuous improvement activities related to reconciliation and open-item management. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Coordination 
 Build effective working relationships across Procurement, Logistics, AP, Finance, and Business functions to accelerate resolution of complex reconciliation issues. Influence stakeholders to prioritize aged, high-risk, and financially significant open items. Challenge unclear ownership, insufficient action plans, and recurring delays that impact account reconciliation and balance sheet integrity. Align cross-functional teams on required actions, responsibilities, and resolution timelines. Act as a trusted point of contact for reconciliation matters, providing clear explanations of balances, risks, and required remediation actions. Support internal and external audits through effective stakeholder coordination, issue resolution, and balance sheet transparency. Reporting & Analytics 
 Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Provide management with actionable insights and recommendations based on analytical findings. Support KPI monitoring and reporting related to reconciliation performance and issue resolution. 
 Candidate Profile 
 5 + years of experience as an Accounts Payable Analyst, Account Reconciliation Analyst or in a similar finance operations role. Experience in accounting, balance sheet reconciliation, financial operations, or open-item management. Strong understanding of end-to-end Accounts Payable process, goods receipt, invoice processing, payment, and clearing flows. Proven ability to analyze and reconcile GRIR, Trade, Leasing, Consignment, and other clearing or control account balances. Ability to interpret balances, open items, aging, variances, and transaction-level details to identify root causes and required actions. Experience working with SAP FI and MM modules; ability to navigate financial and procurement-related postings and documents (S/4HANA exposure preferred). Strong analytical mindset, advanced Microsoft Excel skills, and ability to work with large data sets. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to clarify accountability, drive required actions and persistently follow through until sustainable resolution is achieved.

Key Skills: Sheet,SAP,Reconciliation,Balance Sheet Reconciliation,Balance,Accounting,Balance Sheet,Accounts reconciliation

Full ownership of accounting, GST, TDS, MIS and audit for two group entities. Own day-to-day accounting, GST and TDS compliance, receivables and payables, MIS and audits for two Prime AssetSource group companies, and lead a small team. What you will do: Own day-to-day accounting for two Prime AssetSource group entities in Tally ERP / Tally Prime: sales, purchases, journals, bank reconciliations, ledger scrutiny and monthly closing. Run full GST compliance (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, ITC reconciliation, e-way bills) and TDS compliance (calculation, monthly payment, 24Q / 26Q returns) for both companies; liaise with consultants on Income Tax and ROC filings. Manage payables and receivables: vendor payments, customer invoicing, collections, petty cash, bank transactions and day-to-day fund flow across both entities. Prepare monthly MIS, PL, balance sheets and cash flow reports; track receivable and payable ageing; flag cash-flow risks; support budgeting, cost control and planning. Lead and mentor a small accounts team, coordinate statutory, internal and tax audits, and be the single point of contact for accounts and finance for both companies. Key skills: Tally ERP / Tally Prime, GST Filing (GSTR-1 / 3B / 9), TDS Filing (24Q / 26Q), Bank Reconciliation, Accounts Payable Receivable, MIS PL Reporting, Multi-Company Accounting, MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), Audit Coordination, Inventory in Tally, Petty Cash Banking, ROC Statutory Compliance Work mode: Work from office Education: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance); semi-qualified CA / CMA welcome

Experience in financial statement preparation, account reconciliations, and statutory compliance. Knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems and proficiency in MS Excel. Good analytical, communication, coordination, and documentation skills. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Financial Reporting and Accounting Assist in the preparation and finalisation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Prepare and maintain schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents for financial reporting. Perform general ledger scrutiny and balance sheet reconciliations. Assist in monthly and annual book closure activities, including provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other journal entries. Support the preparation of financial reports and MIS for management review. Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies. Assist in fixed asset accounting, depreciation calculations, and related reconciliations. Coordinate with internal departments to resolve accounting discrepancies and obtain supporting documents. Support statutory and internal audits by preparing schedules and responding to audit queries. 
 B. Direct Taxation Assist in the preparation of corporate income tax computations and advance tax calculations. Support the preparation and filing of income tax returns within prescribed timelines. Ensure timely deduction, deposit, and filing of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS). Prepare TDS workings, reconciliations, and supporting schedules. Assist in tax audits and preparation of information required by tax auditors. Support responses to income tax notices and assessments under the guidance of the reporting manager. Assist in the calculation and reconciliation of current tax and deferred tax provisions. Monitor changes in income tax provisions and support implementation of applicable compliance requirements. Maintain proper documentation of tax payments, returns, assessments, and other statutory records. 
 C. Indirect Taxation GST Assist in the preparation and filing of GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. Reconcile Input Tax Credit (ITC) as per books of accounts with GSTR-2B. title: Accounts executive
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE Atlas Engineering & Inspection Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Accounts Executive to support the U.S. finance operations of our client in the United States. This is an execution-focused role. You will prepare accurate invoices from timesheets, contracts and addenda, follow up receivables, validate bi-weekly U.S. payroll inputs, perform bank and credit card reconciliations and keep audit-ready records, working closely with U.S.-based Operations, Payroll and Business Development teams. 
 WHAT YOU WILL DO Prepare invoices accurately from approved rates, contracts, addenda, work orders and verified timesheets. Maintain the billing calendar and resolve missing, incorrect or disputed billing inputs with Operations and BD-OPS. Submit invoices by email or client portals with complete backup documentation. Run structured AR follow-ups, maintain AR ageing reports and escalate overdue accounts. Validate bi-weekly U.S. payroll inputs: hours, overtime, PTO, leave, differentials, bonuses and adjustments. Perform weekly and monthly bank, credit card, billing-versus-payment and payroll journal reconciliations. Enter expenses, vendor bills and journal entries, and maintain ledgers, trackers and payroll logs. Prepare audit-ready documentation and coordinate with chartered accountants and U.S. finance teams.
