 Experience 35 years of hands-on experience in invoicing, bookkeeping, reconciliations and AR management. Strong experience with timesheet-based invoicing. Experience supporting U.S.-based accounting, payroll or finance teams is a plus.

title: UK Accountant Xero Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Accountant to manage the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of our UK-based furniture retail business. 
 The ideal candidate must have strong practical experience with Xero accounting software, particularly UK accounting practices, VAT, reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, financial reporting, and general ledger management. 
 The candidate should be comfortable independently handling regular accounting operations, maintaining accurate financial records, and supporting monthly and annual financial reporting. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. VAT & UK Tax Compliance Handle UK VAT accounting, VAT calculations, VAT returns, and reconciliations. Ensure accurate VAT treatment of purchases, sales, expenses, and transactions. Maintain proper VAT records and supporting documentation. Understand UK VAT rules and accounting requirements. 
 2. Bank & Account Reconciliations Perform regular bank reconciliations in Xero. Reconcile supplier accounts, customer accounts, and balance sheet accounts. Investigate and resolve discrepancies and unreconciled transactions. Ensure all financial records are accurate and up to date. 
 3. Accounts Payable & Receivable Manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR). Process supplier invoices, customer invoices, credit notes, and payments. Track outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue payments. Manage supplier statements and payment reconciliations. Ensure timely and accurate recording of all transactions. 
 4. Xero Accounting & Bookkeeping Maintain and manage the general ledger. Handle journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and adjustments. Manage intercompany transactions and transfers. Maintain accurate chart of accounts and accounting records. Perform day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting activities using Xero. 
 5. Financial Reporting & Budgeting Prepare monthly profit and loss statements and balance sheet reports. Track monthly and annual income and expenditure. Assist with annual budgeting, expense forecasting, and variance analysis. Monitor business expenses and identify discrepancies or unusual spending. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. 
 6. General Accounting Responsibilities Maintain accurate financial documentation and records. Assist with year-end accounts preparation and coordination with UK accountants. Handle other accounting and financial administration tasks as required. Ensure accounting processes are completed accurately and within deadlines. 
 Required Skills 
 Strong practical experience with Xero accounting software is essential. Good knowledge of UK accounting practices and UK VAT regulations. Strong understanding of bank reconciliations, AP, AR, general ledger, and financial reporting. Experience handling intercompany transactions and reconciliations. Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy. Ability to work independently and manage accounting responsibilities with minimal supervision. 
 Good written and verbal communication skills.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Role Overview As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Finance Manager to own the numbers for our global entities and run the finance operations underneath them. The role is based in our Kochi office full time, and reports to the Financial Controller in Bangalore within a finance team led by the CFO in London. Your working day needs a consistent overlap with UK hours, particularly through close. The ideal candidate is a qualified accountant with hands-on experience of bookkeeping, balance sheet reconciliations and statutory compliance. You will deliver a PL and balance sheet that are reconciled, explained and ready for the Financial Controller to sign off without rework, and keep filings on time, working closely with our external consultants. The Finance Manager will run the month-end close up to trial balance, support the Financial Controller on consolidation, and own every balance sheet reconciliation for all group entities. You will be central to bringing accounting in house from external providers and to our move from Xero to a new AI-native ERP. Key Responsibilities Accounting and Bookkeeping: Manage day-to-day accounting for the multi-entity group, ensuring the completeness and accuracy of the books. You will maintain clean books with strong audit records. Month-End Close: Own the close for all group entities up to a reviewed trial balance. Run the close calendar, chase inputs, post the required journals, and deliver to the Financial Controller on time. Balance Sheet Reconciliations: Prepare every reconciliation, every month - bank, receivables, payables, accruals, prepayments, deferred and accrued income, payroll control accounts, GST and VAT, fixed assets and intercompany - reconciled to source with reconciling items explained and cleared. Customer Billing, Collections and Revenue: Ensure timely and accurate customer billing through our finance systems. Publish a weekly ageing tracker for customer balances, follow up on collections, and resolve discrepancies. Help improve the overall customer billing experience. Maintain revenue schedules for multi-year contracts billed in multiple currencies, tying invoicing, deferred income and recognised revenue together. Accounts Payable and Expense Management: Manage end-to-end vendor invoice processing, from obtaining approvals and booking invoices in our finance systems to processing payments on time, and own supplier set-up and the expense-claims process. Payroll Processing: Collaborate with the external payroll consultant and the HR team to process payroll. Manage the payroll cycle proactively and adhere strictly to timelines. Audit: Build and maintain the audit files for all group entities and act as the auditors first point of contact on the detail. Statutory Compliance: Work with our advisers and input into the preparation and filing of tax and regulatory returns, including GST, TDS, SEZ, VAT and other global requirements ERP, Automation and Finance Process Change: Act as a key user on our ERP implementation and use AI tools and agentic workflows to transform how Finance operates. Support the Financial Controller and CFO on finance process changes and ad hoc projects as required. Skills and Experience Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with a Big 4 experience. 2 to 5+ years post-qualification in-house finance experience, ideally closing the books of an Indian subsidiary for a UK or US parent, in a software, services or startup business. Sound understanding of Indian accounting standards (IGAAP) and financial statements, and a strong grounding in IFRS or UK GAAP. Experience owning or contributing to a multi-entity month-end close, and preparing a full set of balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules. Experience preparing audit files and working directly with auditors. Working knowledge of Indian and UK tax and statutory requirements. Strong attention to detail, with discipline around deadlines and follow-ups. Comfort with a modern finance technology stack and change, and hands-on use of AI tools in your own work today. A strong sense of ownership, urgency and accountability, and a willingness to learn. Clear written and spoken English and the confidence to deal directly with senior colleagues in global locations and to bring your own opinion. Location Kochi, Kerala We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and locations. For candidates based outside Kochi, we offer a relocation allowance to support a smooth transition.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Below is a comprehensive Job Description (JD) for Finance Controller tailored for a renewable energy business with solar, wind, hybrid, and captive power projects.
 Finance Controller 
 Location- Mumbai Corporate office 
 Reporting To Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
 Position Summary 
The Finance Controller will lead the finance and accounting function, ensuring robust financial governance, accurate reporting, regulatory compliance, treasury management, project finance support, and business partnering for renewable energy operations. The role requires strong expertise in financial control, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, project accounting, and stakeholder management within infrastructure, energy, or renewable sectors.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Control & Reporting 
 Lead the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with Ind AS and applicable statutory requirements. Ensure timely closing of books and preparation of management reports. Develop and maintain robust financial controls, accounting policies, and reporting processes. Monitor financial performance and recommend corrective actions to achieve business objectives. Analyse variances against budgets and forecasts and provide management insights. Budgeting & Business Planning 
 Drive annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning. Partner with business leaders to evaluate project profitability and operational efficiency. Establish financial KPIs and monitor business performance. Support strategic initiatives through financial modelling and scenario analysis. Project Finance & Renewable Energy Accounting 
 Oversee accounting and financial monitoring of renewable energy projects including solar, wind, hybrid, and storage projects. Monitor project costs, capital expenditure, and asset capitalization. Ensure compliance with financing agreements, lender covenants, and project-specific requirements. Support project bid evaluations and investment decisions through financial analysis. Audit & Risk Management 
 Lead internal audit, statutory audit, and lender audit activities. Strengthen internal controls and risk management frameworks. Address audit observations and implement corrective actions. Ensure adherence to corporate governance policies. Stakeholder Management 
 Act as a key finance partner to business heads, project teams, procurement, legal, and commercial functions. Support Board, Audit Committee, and senior management reporting. Manage relationships with auditors, consultants, banks, investors, and regulatory authorities. Team Leadership 
 Lead and develop a high-performing finance and accounts team. Drive process improvement, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. Foster a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement. 
 Qualifications 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) mandatory. 
 Additional certifications such as CFA, CMA, or FRM will be an advantage. 
 Experience 
 20-22 years of progressive finance experience. Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing finance and accounting functions. Prior experience in Renewable Energy, Power, Infrastructure, EPC, Utilities, or Energy sectors preferred. Strong preference to candidate having Renewable Energy exposure Exposure to project finance, infrastructure accounting, and lender reporting is highly desirable. 
 Technical Competencies 
 Strong knowledge of Ind AS, Companies Act, and financial reporting standards. Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, treasury, and financial planning. Sound knowledge of GST, direct taxation, and regulatory compliance. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms. Advanced financial modelling and analytical skills. Strong understanding of project accounting and infrastructure finance. 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Strategic thinking and commercial acumen and assist CEO/ CFO in decision making Excellent stakeholder management skills. Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. High level of integrity and governance orientation. Should have good interpersonal skills to handle senior management. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 Key Success Metrics 
 Timely and accurate financial reporting. Zero significant audit and compliance issues. Effective cash flow and working capital management. Budget adherence and financial performance improvement. Strengthened financial controls and governance. Successful support of project financing and growth initiatives.

title: Export Sales Coordinator
description:
You will be the person who makes sure right quotes are sent to the clients and an order goes right after the client says yes: chasing our factories for production and dispatch, and looking after our overseas customers until the goods are delivered and any issue is closed. 
 Company India Pack (indiapack.co.in) Location - Chinchwad, Pune on-site Type - Full-time, permanent Experience - 0-7 years; freshers with strong written English are welcome 
 Reports to - Co-founder Working days - MonSat (Sundays Off) (Alternate Saturdays off after probation) 
 About India Pack India Pack is a Pune-based B2B packaging sourcing company, now about 10 years old. We supply FIBCs (jumbo bags), PP woven bags, BOPP bags, flexible pouches and container liners from 10+ audited Indian manufacturers to buyers in the UK, Germany, Scandinavia, the USA and the Middle East. 
 What you will do After-sales support (customers) Be the day-to-day contact for international customers once an order is confirmed: order status, dispatch dates, shipping documents. Send shipment updates before the customer has to ask, and confirm delivery at their end. Share and file order documents: invoice, packing list, bill of lading, test reports and certificates. Register every complaint or quality claim the day it arrives. Collect photos, quantities, batch details and usage conditions from the customer. Work with the supplier and our technical team to find the cause, agree the corrective action, and keep the customer updated until the claim is closed. Follow up after delivery for feedback and pass repeat-order signals to the sales team. Supplier coordination (factories) Follow up with our manufacturing partners by phone and email on production schedules, samples, print proofs and dispatch readiness. Track each order from purchase order to shipment and keep the order tracker and ERP/CRM up to date. Flag delays or spec deviations early, with a revised date and a proposed fix, not just the problem. Coordinate pre-shipment inspections and check test reports against the customer's specification. Collect supplier documents on time so that shipping paperwork is never the reason for a delay. Reporting Maintain the open-orders and open-claims lists and present a short status every week. Who we are looking for Must have A graduate in any stream (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc, BE or a diploma are all fine). Clear, polite written English. Most of your day is email with overseas customers. Comfortable speaking Hindi on the phone with factory teams. Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: filters, sorting, simple formulas. A habit of following up without being reminded, and of writing things down. Calm with an unhappy customer: you listen, collect the facts, and respond the same day. Good to have Exposure to export documentation, Incoterms or freight forwarding. A background in packaging, plastics, textiles or any manufacturing environment. Experience with an ERP or CRM or a shared helpdesk inbox. Gujarati or Marathi for supplier conversations. What you will get Daily, direct work with customers in Europe, the USA and the Middle East from your first month. Hands-on training in FIBC and woven packaging products, quality standards and the export process from order to delivery. A small team where you work directly with the founders and your work is visible. A growth path to Account Manager, owning a set of customers and suppliers end to end. title: Cost Accountant / MIS & Costing Manager
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Cost Accountant / Cost Control professional who will be responsible for monitoring operational costs, site-level expenses, MIS reporting, P&L management and financial controls. The role requires close coordination with operational teams and sites to ensure effective cost management and accurate financial reporting. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Cost Control & Monitoring Closely monitor operational expenses and identify areas of cost leakage or unnecessary expenditure. Track and control site-wise costs and ensure expenses remain within approved budgets. Monitor electricity and utility expenses across sites and identify variances. Analyse cost trends and provide actionable inputs to management. MIS & P&L Management Prepare and maintain monthly MIS reports covering operational costs, revenues and profitability. Assist in preparation, monitoring and management of monthly P&L statements. Analyse actual vs. budgeted expenses and highlight significant variances. Provide regular financial and operational reports to senior management. 
 Site & Operational Coordination Closely coordinate with various operational sites for cost monitoring and reporting. Supervise and review site-level financial/operational data. Ensure timely collection and validation of expense and operational information from sites. Conduct regular follow-ups with site teams regarding discrepancies and pending data. 
 Audit & Compliance Coordinate with CA firms / external auditors for site audits and financial reviews. Support internal and external audit requirements by providing accurate records and documentation. Verify expenses, supporting documents and financial entries to ensure accuracy and compliance. Data Management & Reporting Maintain accurate financial and operational data. Perform regular data entry, reconciliation and verification. Ensure timely updating of financial records and MIS databases. Identify discrepancies in data and coordinate with concerned teams for resolution. 
 Required Skills Strong understanding of cost accounting and cost control Good knowledge of P&L and financial reporting Experience in MIS preparation and analysis Experience in site-level cost/expense monitoring Good Excel and data-handling skills Ability to analyse financial data and identify variances Good coordination and follow-up skills Experience dealing with CA firms/auditors Strong attention to detail and accuracy Ability to work closely with operational/site teams 
 Candidate Profile Candidate should have 5to 9 years of relevant experience in cost accounting, finance operations, cost control, MIS or a similar role. Candidates with B.Com and CA Inter / relevant professional finance qualifications and good practical exposure to P&L management, site audits, cost monitoring and operational finance would be preferred.

title: Sr. Manager- Direct Taxation
description:
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory Job Title: Senior Manager – Direct Taxation Job Description We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager – Direct Tax to lead and manage direct tax matters, ensuring tax compliance, effective tax planning, and timely resolution of tax-related issues. The role will work closely with finance, business, legal, and senior management teams to provide strategic tax advice and ensure compliance with applicable tax laws and regulations. Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Direct Tax Compliance Oversee timely and accurate compliance with the Income-tax Act, 1961 and applicable rules, regulations, and notifications. Review and monitor corporate income-tax returns, tax computations, advance tax, self-assessment tax, and related filings. Ensure timely compliance with TDS/TCS provisions, including return filing, reconciliations, and correction statements. Review tax provisions and deferred tax calculations in coordination with the finance and accounting teams. Monitor tax notices, communications, and statutory requirements. 2. Tax Planning & Advisory Develop and implement effective tax-planning strategies aligned with business objectives. Provide tax advice on business transactions, contracts, investments, restructuring, financing, and other strategic initiatives. Evaluate tax implications of new business models, transactions, and commercial arrangements. Identify opportunities for tax optimisation while maintaining a strong focus on compliance and risk management. 3. Tax Assessments & Litigation Lead and coordinate income-tax assessments, audits, appeals, and other proceedings before tax authorities. Manage interactions with tax consultants, legal advisors, and external counsel. Review responses to tax notices, assessment orders, appeals, and submissions. Track tax litigation matters and assess potential tax exposures and contingent liabilities. Develop appropriate strategies for resolution of tax disputes. 4. Transfer Pricing & International Tax Coordinate with internal teams and external advisors on transfer-pricing compliance and documentation, where applicable. Review international transactions and assess implications under domestic tax laws and applicable tax treaties. Advise on withholding-tax implications for cross-border payments. Support matters relating to DTAA, PE exposure, withholding taxes, and international tax compliance . 5. Tax Risk Management Identify and evaluate direct tax risks across business functions. Establish appropriate tax controls and processes to minimise compliance risks. Monitor changes in tax laws, judicial precedents, CBDT circulars, notifications, and regulatory developments. Assess the impact of significant tax-law changes on the organisation and communicate key implications to stakeholders. 6. Stakeholder Management Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, HR, and business teams on tax-related matters. Present tax positions, risks, and recommendations to senior management. Manage relationships with tax consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities. Drive awareness of tax compliance requirements across relevant business teams. 7. Team Management Lead, mentor, and develop the direct-tax team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor deliverables to ensure timely completion. Build strong tax processes, documentation standards, and knowledge within the team. Review the quality and accuracy of work performed by team members and external advisors. Key Deliverables / KPIs Timely and accurate completion of all direct-tax compliances. Effective management and reduction of tax risks and exposures. Successful management of assessments, audits, and litigation. Optimisation of the organisation’s effective tax rate within the applicable legal framework. Timely identification and implementation of tax-saving opportunities. Accurate tax provisioning and forecasting. Effective management of tax consultants and external advisors. Timely communication of changes in tax laws and their business impact. Strengthening of tax controls and processes. Qualifications CA (Chartered Accountant) – mandatory/preferred. Experience 8–12 years of relevant experience in direct taxation. Strong experience in corporate income tax, TDS, tax assessments, litigation, and tax planning. Exposure to international taxation and transfer pricing would be an advantage. Prior experience in managing a team is preferred. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Indian direct-tax laws and regulations. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong understanding of corporate tax compliance and tax accounting. Experience in handling tax authorities and assessments. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to interpret complex tax provisions and translate them into practical business advice. Strong attention to detail and ownership of deadlines. Good commercial and business understanding. Strong negotiation and presentation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant tax/accounting systems

 About Accenture 

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers.  What would you do? 

 You will be aligned with our Intelligent Finance Operations vertically and will manage a Procure to Pay (P2P) delivery portfolio, helping the client improve payables accuracy, timeliness and controls. You will be part of the team at Accenture s Gurugram Delivery Center (DDC5), managing day-to-day P2P operations, service stabilization and continuous improvement for the assigned scope. Procure to Pay covers PO and non-PO invoice processing, vendor master data management, payment runs, T&E, vendor reconciliations, AP query or helpdesk management and period-end close activities. You will monitor delivery against agreed SLAs and KPIs (invoice cycle time, first-time-right, on-time payment, aged open items), and drive standardization, automation and GenAI or Agentic AI use cases. You will manage team leads and associates, handle escalations, and partner with client AP teams, vendors and Accenture stakeholders to resolve issues and support a controlled period-end close.

 What are we looking for?

description:
About TETR Five years ago, we started Masters Union; our vision: to redefine the landscape of business education. We posed a simple question: If aspiring doctors learn from seasoned physicians and budding lawyers learn from legal experts, why shouldn't future business leaders learn directly from industry experts? 
 After all, can a lecture on Accounting 101 truly compare to the hands-on experience of analyzing real PnL statements? 
 Today, Masters' Union has an unparalleled curriculum with faculty comprising Industry Leaders and practitioners unlike any other in the country. Our academic council includes CXOs, MDs, Eminent Public Leaders, and even Members of Parliament. In just four years of operations, our flagship PGP in Technology and Business Management has achieved remarkable success, surpassing the placement records of esteemed institutions like IIM Ahmedabad and ISB. 
 Masters Union is now ranked among the top 2 B-schools in the country based on placement records. 
 With our growing global recognition, we realized that the hands-on experience of building real businesses, which proved to be highly effective for students in India, could offer immense value to aspiring entrepreneurs worldwide.

Imagine studying at iconic institutions like INSEAD, NUS, SDA Bocconi, and IIT and learning from some of the brightest minds in the business world like Dr. Edward Rogers (Former Chief Knowledge Officer, NASA), Mr. Faverie Stephane (Executive Group President, Estee Lauder) and Mr. Saud Swar (CBO, American Express, MENA). From launching eCommerce ventures in Dubai to tackling tech startups in Silicon Valley, our students traverse the globe, building businesses and making a tangible impact. At Tetr, the world is your classroom.

description:
Job Title: Operations Analyst Department: Risk & Compliance 
 Employment Type: Contractual
 Experience: 0-2 years
 Location: Noida, India
 Qualification: Graduate in any discipline
 Our Story: Founded in 2000 by Dilip Modi, Spice Money Limited is Indias leading rural fintech company, headquartered in Noida and operating as a subsidiary of DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited, a publicly listed entity. The company is driven by a strong mission to accelerate financial inclusion and empower the underserved Bharat” through technology-enabled financial services. With a network of 1.6+ million Adhikaris across India, the company enables last-mile access to essential services including AEPS cash withdrawal and deposits, domestic money transfer, bill payments, insurance, micro-ATM services, credit solutions, travel bookings, account opening, and UPI-led digital payments. Spice Money has consistently introduced industry-first innovations such as a zero-cost Adhikari platform, one of India’s largest assisted payments networks, a rural credit marketplace, and Spice Money UPI & Spice Pay wallet to accelerate digital adoption in smaller towns and villages. Operating across 95%+ pincodes with a team of 1,000+ employees, Spice Money combines the agility of a high-growth fintech with the scale and impact of a nationwide distribution network—creating meaningful economic opportunities and driving the next phase of financial inclusion in India. 
 About the Role We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented fresher to join our Cyber Fraud Operations team. The candidate will support the processing and closure of cases received through the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), and assist in responding to queries and requests received from Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) and other authorities. The role involves case documentation, data analysis, coordination with internal teams, and ensuring timely and accurate responses to authorities. 
 Key Responsibilities Review and process cyber fraud cases received through MHA/I4C channels. Assist in the timely closure of I4C cases in accordance with internal processes and applicable timelines. Prepare and submit responses to Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs), cybercrime authorities, and other authorised government agencies. Coordinate with internal departments such as Risk, Compliance, Operations, Finance, and Customer Support to obtain required information. Maintain accurate case records, trackers, and supporting documentation. Perform data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting using Microsoft Excel. Use basic SQL queries to extract and analyse relevant data from internal databases. Monitor pending cases, follow up on outstanding information, and escalate delays wherever required. Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance while handling sensitive case-related information. Prepare periodic MIS reports and case status updates for internal stakeholders. Support process improvement initiatives to enhance case turnaround time and operational efficiency. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Microsoft Excel: Good working knowledge of Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, COUNTIF/SUMIF, filters, and data formatting. SQL: Basic knowledge of SQL queries, including SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, and JOIN. Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal. Coordination: Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and following up with stakeholders. Analytical Skills: Good attention to detail, logical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities. Documentation: Ability to prepare professional emails, reports, and case-related documentation. Learning Attitude: Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and regulatory requirements. 
 Eligibility Criteria Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. Basic understanding of banking, digital payments, cyber fraud, or financial operations will be an advantage. Candidates with internship experience or academic exposure to Excel and SQL are welcome. No prior professional experience is mandatory. 
 What We Are Looking For A proactive and responsible individual with a strong learning mindset. Someone who can handle repetitive operational tasks with accuracy. A candidate who can manage deadlines and communicate professionally. An individual interested in building a career in Risk, Compliance, Cyber Fraud, or Financial Operations. 
 Interested candidate can share their resume at Kanika.rastogi@spicemoney.com

Lead discovery sessions, architecture workshops, assessments and design reviews. Provide recommendations for modernization, transformation, optimization, risk reduction and service improvement. Support sales and account teams throughout opportunity qualification and solution development. Develop solution architectures, technical proposals, Statements of Work, assumptions, dependencies and solution narratives. Produce effort estimates, Bills of Materials, licensing assumptions and technical inputs to commercial models. Lead customer presentations, solution workshops, demonstrations and technical defence sessions. Ensure proposed solutions are technically achievable, operationally supportable and commercially viable. 4. Conduct design assurance and technical reviews at defined architecture and delivery gates. Manage architecture decisions, technical risks, exceptions, constraints and dependencies. Support delivery teams in resolving complex architecture and integration issues. Define solution acceptance criteria and contribute to testing, transition and operational readiness. Maintain appropriate documentation, traceability and architecture governance. 5. Technology Leadership The successful candidate should demonstrate sound architecture knowledge across several of the following domains: Domain Expected capability Cloud Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services and/or Google Cloud Platform Infrastructure Compute, storage, virtualization, backup and platform services Networking Enterprise networking, SD-WAN, DNS/DHCP, load balancing and connectivity Security Zero Trust, identity and access management, endpoint, network and cloud security Applications Application modernization, APIs, middleware and integration architecture Data Data platforms, integration, governance and cloud data services Automation Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, CI/CD and orchestration Operations ITSM, monitoring, observability, service management and operational readiness Emerging technology AI, generative AI, automation and modern digital platforms 6. Security by Design Embed security into the architecture from initial design rather than treating it as a downstream activity. Align solutions with enterprise security standards, regulatory requirements and customer policies. Incorporate identity, privileged access, encryption, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, network segmentation and data protection controls. Collaborate with specialist cybersecurity architects where deeper domain expertise is required. Apply appropriate risk assessment and threat-modelling techniques for critical solutions. 7. Architecture Leadership and Mentoring Provide technical direction to solution architects, domain architects, consultants and engineers. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams contributing to complex solutions and review their architecture deliverables. Mentor junior and intermediate architects and promote consistent architecture practices. Support the development of architecture capability, communities of practice and technical standards. 8. Innovation and Reusable Intellectual Property Develop reusable reference architectures, patterns, templates, blueprints and accelerators. Contribute lessons learned and delivery experience to Fujitsu knowledge repositories. Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their applicability to customer requirements. Participate in architecture communities, technology forums and thought-leadership activities. Collaborate with strategic technology partners to enhance Fujitsu solution offerings. Required Experience 15+ years of relevant IT experience, including approximately 8+ years in solution, technical or enterprise architecture. Proven experience architecting large-scale enterprise technology solutions across multiple technology domains. Experience producing HLDs, LLDs, architecture documents, technical proposals and implementation roadmaps. Previous involvement in RFPs, proposals, solution estimation and pre-sales activities. Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering and delivery teams. Ability to evaluate solutions from business, technical, security, risk, operational and commercial perspectives. Professional Competencies Architecture leadership: ownership of complex end-to-end architecture and design decisions. Customer focus: ability to understand desired business outcomes rather than proposing technology in isolation. Commercial awareness: understanding of solution cost, effort, risk and architectural trade-offs. Communication: excellent written, verbal, workshop-facilitation and presentation skills. Problem solving: a structured, evidence-based approach to complex business and technical challenges. Stakeholder management: confidence working with customer executives, architects, vendors and delivery teams. Collaboration and leadership: ability to influence geographically distributed and multidisciplinary teams without relying solely on formal authority. Qualifications and Certifications Education

description:
Role & responsibilities 
 The Credit Manager - SBE is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of Small Business Enterprise customers, evaluating loan proposals, mitigating credit risk, and ensuring adherence to the Bank's credit policies and regulatory guidelines. The role focuses on supporting business growth through prudent underwriting while maintaining portfolio quality and asset performance. Key Responsibilities Credit Appraisal & Assessment Analyze loan applications, financial statements, banking transactions, GST data, bureau reports, and other relevant documents to assess borrower eligibility. Evaluate business cash flows, repayment capacity, leverage, and operational performance. Conduct detailed credit assessments for SBE customers across various industries and business segments. Risk Evaluation Identify and assess risks associated with lending proposals. Credit Decisioning Recommend approval, modification, or rejection of credit proposals based on policy guidelines and risk assessment. Ensure adherence to delegated authority and turnaround time (TAT) commitments. Portfolio Monitoring Monitor the performance of approved accounts and identify Early Warning Signals (EWS). Track delinquencies, overdue accounts, and portfolio quality indicators to initiate timely corrective actions. Policy & Compliance Ensure compliance with internal credit policies, RBI guidelines, audit requirements, and regulatory standards. Maintain proper documentation and adherence to all operational and credit risk controls. Customer & Stakeholder Management Work closely with Relationship Managers, Sales Teams, Operations, Legal, Risk, and Collections teams. Provide credit guidance and support business teams in achieving growth objectives while maintaining risk discipline. Financial Analysis Assess balance sheets, profit & loss statements, cash flow statements, bank statements, and working capital requirements. Evaluate collateral coverage, debt servicing ability, and overall financial health of borrowers. Reporting & MIS Prepare credit notes, portfolio reviews, risk reports, and management MIS. Present key portfolio trends, exposure analysis, and risk observations to stakeholders.

title: Accounts Reconciliation
description:
Account Reconciliation Analyst / Senior Analyst 
 
 The Role 
The Account Reconciliation Analyst is responsible for analyzing, reconciling, and driving resolution of GR/IR, Trade, Leasing, Consignment, and other clearing or control account balances. The role focuses on reducing aged open items through detailed investigation, root-cause analysis, and coordination of corrective actions across Procurement, Accounts Payable, Logistics, Receiving, and Finance teams. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Open-Item Analysis & Resolution 
 Perform detailed analysis of GR/IR, Trade, Leasing, Consignment, and other clearing or control account balances. Review aged open items, unresolved balances, and recurring exceptions requiring investigation and action. Investigate discrepancies across purchase orders, goods receipts, supplier invoices, delivery documents, approvals, and accounting postings. Identify root causes of outstanding balances, draw conclusions, and define corrective actions with the appropriate stakeholders. Drive resolution of aged, complex, and unclear ownership items through effective follow-up, stakeholder engagement, and escalation where necessary. Ensure outstanding items are properly explained, documented, and resolved to support balance sheet integrity and prevent recurrence. 
 Account Reconciliation & Financial Close Support 
 Prepare and perform balance sheet reconciliations for assigned accounts in accordance with company policies and financial controls. Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities for assigned reconciliation areas. Validate account balances, investigate variances, interpret open items, and provide clear supporting documentation. Ensure reconciliation activities are completed accurately, on time, and with appropriate evidence for review and control purposes. Maintain reconciliation records and analysis to support internal and external audit requirements. Root Cause Analysis & Process Improvement 
 Analyze recurring reconciliation issues and identify process weaknesses across Accounts Payable flows. Recommend corrective actions to reduce aged balances, blocked invoices, clearing differences, and recurring open items. Work with Procurement, AP Operations, Logistics, Receiving, Business users, and Finance teams to improve data quality, process compliance, and transaction accuracy. Support standardization, reporting improvements, and continuous improvement activities related to reconciliation and open-item management. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Coordination 
 Build effective working relationships across Procurement, Logistics, AP, Finance, and Business functions to accelerate resolution of complex reconciliation issues. Influence stakeholders to prioritize aged, high-risk, and financially significant open items. Challenge unclear ownership, insufficient action plans, and recurring delays that impact account reconciliation and balance sheet integrity. Align cross-functional teams on required actions, responsibilities, and resolution timelines. Act as a trusted point of contact for reconciliation matters, providing clear explanations of balances, risks, and required remediation actions. Support internal and external audits through effective stakeholder coordination, issue resolution, and balance sheet transparency. Reporting & Analytics 
 Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Provide management with actionable insights and recommendations based on analytical findings. Support KPI monitoring and reporting related to reconciliation performance and issue resolution. 
 Candidate Profile 
 5 + years of experience as an Accounts Payable Analyst, Account Reconciliation Analyst or in a similar finance operations role. Experience in accounting, balance sheet reconciliation, financial operations, or open-item management. Strong understanding of end-to-end Accounts Payable process, goods receipt, invoice processing, payment, and clearing flows. Proven ability to analyze and reconcile GRIR, Trade, Leasing, Consignment, and other clearing or control account balances. Ability to interpret balances, open items, aging, variances, and transaction-level details to identify root causes and required actions. Experience working with SAP FI and MM modules; ability to navigate financial and procurement-related postings and documents (S/4HANA exposure preferred). Strong analytical mindset, advanced Microsoft Excel skills, and ability to work with large data sets. Strong ownership mindset with the ability to clarify accountability, drive required actions and persistently follow through until sustainable resolution is achieved.

Key Skills: Sheet,SAP,Reconciliation,Balance Sheet Reconciliation,Balance,Accounting,Balance Sheet,Accounts reconciliation

title: Senior Business Central Functional Consultant
description:
We are looking for Senior Business Central Functional Consultant Experience 8+ years in Dynamics 365 Business Central functional consulting, including at least 3 full-cycle implementations as lead functional consultant on Business Central SaaS 
 We are looking for a Senior Business Central Functional Consultant to lead the design and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central SaaS for a multi-company leasing and rental business. You will run discovery workshops, design finance, lease and billing processes, configure Business Central, lead data migration, testing and cut-over, and support users through go-live and hypercare. Key responsibilities Lead discovery and requirement workshops with finance, operations and management, and document the current and future business processes. Produce fit-gap analyses, functional design documents and functional specifications for customisations and integrations, working closely with the development team. Configure Business Central for several companies: chart of accounts, dimensions, posting groups, number series, VAT, payment terms, approval workflows and user set-up. Design lease and rental processes: head leases with a funding bank, sub-leases, recurring and contract-based billing, end-of-contract options (renew, extend, terminate, purchase) and revenue-share settlements. Agree the fixed asset, depreciation and lease accounting treatment with the finance team and auditors. Design intercompany processes between companies, including companies in separate Business Central environments, and the ownership of shared master data. Design service management processes for equipment maintenance (service items, service contracts and service orders) and their link to billing. Configure the Belgian localisation: VAT statements and returns, VAT and enterprise numbers, CODA bank statements and electronic invoicing. Lead data migration: data mapping, cleansing rules, configuration packages, opening balances, open transactions, historical G/L balances, reconciliation and business sign-off. Define the cut-over plan and go-live checklist, aligned with the month-end and financial year timing. Plan and run testing: test scenarios and scripts, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage and sign-off. Define roles and permission sets with appropriate segregation of duties. Set up financial reporting (Financial Reports, Excel reports) and define reporting needs for Power BI and multi-language document layouts. Prepare training material and user guides, and train key users and end users. Provide go-live and hypercare support, and hand over to the support team. Manage functional scope, change requests, risks and decisions, and report progress to project management. Work with other Business Central partners and third-party providers on shared processes and integrations. Required skills and experience 8+ years of functional implementation experience in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including at least 3 full-cycle implementations as lead functional consultant on Business Central SaaS. Strong finance knowledge: general ledger, payables, receivables, cash management, bank reconciliation, fixed assets, VAT, dimensions, intercompany, consolidation, and month-end and year-end closing. Good working knowledge of Sales, Purchasing, Service Management and Inventory in Business Central. Experience with contract-based or recurring billing in Business Central, such as Subscription Billing or lease and rental solutions, and an understanding of lease accounting (IFRS 16 / Belgian GAAP). Experience with the Belgian (BE) localisation: VAT statements, VAT and enterprise numbers, and CODA bank statements. Proven experience leading data migration from legacy ERP systems into Business Central: data mapping, configuration packages, opening balances, history and reconciliation. Experience with multi-company set-ups, intercompany postings and Business Central SaaS environments (sandbox and production). Ability to write clear functional specifications for AL developers, and a good understanding of integrations, APIs and data flows. Experience planning and running user acceptance testing, cut-over and go-live. Experience configuring workflows, approvals, permission sets and financial reports. Good to have Accounting qualification or finance background, such as CA, ACCA or CIMA. Experience in leasing, rental, equipment finance or other asset-based businesses. Experience in electronic invoicing, using the Business Central E-Documents framework. Experience with revenue-share arrangements or high-volume transaction billing. Power Platform: Power Automate and Power BI reporting on Business Central data. Experience with requirement and test management tools, such as Azure DevOps or Jira. Experience with migrations from Dynamics NAV or other on-premises ERP systems to Business Central SaaS. Microsoft certification, such as MB-800 (Business Central Functional Consultant). Working knowledge of French or Dutch. Soft skills Clear communication with both business users and technical teams. Confident workshop facilitation and stakeholder management, including senior finance users. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with clear and structured documentation. Able to work independently, own deliverables and manage priorities across projects. Comfortable leading functional discussions and mentoring other consultants. Experience working with client teams and other implementation partners across time zones .

description:
At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we re supporting our customers financial confidence, advancing digital commerce, or enabling people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what s possible. We provide opportunities to learn, grow, innovate, and build meaningful careers while fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and integrity. Together, we ll lead the way in delivering innovative, secure, and reliable technology solutions that power millions of customer interactions every day. Join #TeamAmex and lets lead the way together. 

 About Enterprise Identity SRE Application Support Enterprise Identity is the foundation of American Expresss digital customer experience, enabling secure, seamless, and reliable authentication and authorization across our digital ecosystem. The Enterprise Identity Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Application Support organization plays a critical role in ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, security, and operational resilience of mission-critical Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms. Our technology ecosystem includes customer authentication and logon services, OAuth-based authorization capabilities supporting Open Banking, customer identity systems of record such as Product Registry and Profile, and advanced authentication and verification capabilities including One Auth, AuthN+, and Verification Services. Operating in a highly distributed, always-on environment, our teams support platforms with availability objectives of 99.99% and above. Through a global follow-the-sun support model spanning the United States and India, we deliver 24x7x365 operational coverage. We partner closely with Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Delivery teams to engineer reliability into our platforms, accelerate automation, improve observability, and continuously enhance production stability. How Will You Make an Impact in This Role We are seeking a technically accomplished and results-driven Manager Tech Ops Engineering - Enterprise Identity SRE Application Support to lead a team of engineers responsible for the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of critical customer identity platforms. This is a hands-on technical leadership position requiring strong expertise in site reliability engineering, modern application architectures, cloud-native technologies, production troubleshooting, observability, and automation. The successful candidate will combine deep engineering knowledge with strong people leadership to drive operational transformation, reduce production incidents, improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore/Recover (MTTR), and establish scalable, proactive, and automated reliability practices. You will serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex production challenges, working across engineering and business teams to improve system resilience, eliminate recurring issues, and enable reliable delivery of new capabilities. Beyond managing day-to-day operations, you will help evolve traditional application support into an engineering-driven SRE organization focused on automation, proactive detection, self-healing, and continuous reliability improvement.

title: Vacancy : Deputy Manager - Trailer operations
description:
Job Purpose To manage and oversee end-to-end export trailer operations, with a primary focus on reefer and dry trailer transportation. The role involves demand and capacity planning, transporter management, trailer deployment, vessel coordination, detention control, and operational performance monitoring to ensure timely and cost-effective movement of export cargo. 
 Key Responsibilities Demand & Supply Planning Analyze the demand and supply of reefer trailers for export movements. Ensure adequate availability of reefer and dry trailers based on export requirements and shipping schedules. Forecast trailer requirements in coordination with export and logistics teams. Transporter Management & Development Identify, evaluate, and develop new reefer trailer transporters to strengthen the transportation network. Negotiate and finalize transportation contracts, commercial terms, and service-level agreements with transporters. Maintain effective relationships with existing transporters to ensure consistent service availability and operational efficiency. Export Movement Planning & Execution Plan and coordinate export trailer movements in line with shipping requirements and vessel schedules. Arrange reefer and dry trailers from the market as per operational requirements. Ensure timely placement of trailers at designated locations to meet cargo loading and vessel cut-off timelines. Coordinate with internal stakeholders, transporters, shipping lines, and other relevant parties for smooth execution of export movements. Trailer Operations & Performance Management Monitor trailer placement, utilization, and turnaround time (TAT). Manage and control trailer detention to minimize operational delays and additional costs. Ensure efficient deployment and optimum utilization of reefer and dry trailers. Proactively resolve operational challenges affecting trailer availability and movement. MIS & Reporting Prepare and maintain regular Trailer Operations MIS reports. description:
Below is a comprehensive Job Description (JD) for Finance Controller tailored for a renewable energy business with solar, wind, hybrid, and captive power projects.
 Finance Controller 
 Location- Mumbai Corporate office 
 Reporting To Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
 Position Summary 
The Finance Controller will lead the finance and accounting function, ensuring robust financial governance, accurate reporting, regulatory compliance, treasury management, project finance support, and business partnering for renewable energy operations. The role requires strong expertise in financial control, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, project accounting, and stakeholder management within infrastructure, energy, or renewable sectors.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Control & Reporting

Ensure timely closing of books and preparation of management reports. Develop and maintain robust financial controls, accounting policies, and reporting processes. Monitor financial performance and recommend corrective actions to achieve business objectives. Analyse variances against budgets and forecasts and provide management insights. Budgeting & Business Planning 
 Drive annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning. Partner with business leaders to evaluate project profitability and operational efficiency. Establish financial KPIs and monitor business performance. Support strategic initiatives through financial modelling and scenario analysis. Project Finance & Renewable Energy Accounting 
 Oversee accounting and financial monitoring of renewable energy projects including solar, wind, hybrid, and storage projects. Monitor project costs, capital expenditure, and asset capitalization. Ensure compliance with financing agreements, lender covenants, and project-specific requirements. Support project bid evaluations and investment decisions through financial analysis. Audit & Risk Management 
 Lead internal audit, statutory audit, and lender audit activities. Strengthen internal controls and risk management frameworks. Address audit observations and implement corrective actions. Ensure adherence to corporate governance policies. Stakeholder Management 
 Act as a key finance partner to business heads, project teams, procurement, legal, and commercial functions. Support Board, Audit Committee, and senior management reporting. Manage relationships with auditors, consultants, banks, investors, and regulatory authorities. Team Leadership 
 Lead and develop a high-performing finance and accounts team. Drive process improvement, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. Foster a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement. 
 Qualifications 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) mandatory. 
 Additional certifications such as CFA, CMA, or FRM will be an advantage. 
 Experience

Prior experience in Renewable Energy, Power, Infrastructure, EPC, Utilities, or Energy sectors preferred. Strong preference to candidate having Renewable Energy exposure Exposure to project finance, infrastructure accounting, and lender reporting is highly desirable. 
 Technical Competencies 
 Strong knowledge of Ind AS, Companies Act, and financial reporting standards. Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, treasury, and financial planning. Sound knowledge of GST, direct taxation, and regulatory compliance. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms. Advanced financial modelling and analytical skills. Strong understanding of project accounting and infrastructure finance. 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Strategic thinking and commercial acumen and assist CEO/ CFO in decision making Excellent stakeholder management skills. Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. High level of integrity and governance orientation. Should have good interpersonal skills to handle senior management. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 Key Success Metrics 
 Timely and accurate financial reporting. Zero significant audit and compliance issues. Effective cash flow and working capital management. Budget adherence and financial performance improvement. Strengthened financial controls and governance. Successful support of project financing and growth initiatives.

This is a full-time job. You lead the business analysis program. You are responsible for the quality, traceability, and sign-off readiness of the requirements. You lead the discovery of requirements. You change business needs into data rules, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria that you can test. You manage the backlog of work for the client. You prioritize the backlog and control changes with a model that agrees with the program management office (PMO). You set the sequence of deliverables across the program. These items must be approved before the dashboard and automation work that depends on them starts: master data management (MDM) rules, data ownership, key performance indicator (KPI) definitions, and data standards. The role covers these areas: Master data, governance, and alignment with D365 FO Microsoft Fabric data platform, analytics, and Power BI Process automation and business controls Responsibilities You are responsible for five areas. One area is governance, which applies to all work. The other four areas are workstreams. Requirements governance and BA leadership Lead the business analysis program. Set the BA standard: templates, traceability, criteria for when work is ready and when work is done, and program governance criteria. Run discovery with client stakeholders. Own the requirements backlog. Own the RAID (risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies), decision, and change-control logs. Report the status to the steering group. Own the acceptance process: user acceptance testing (UAT), defect triage, cutover readiness, and handover to business-as-usual (BAU) operations. Sequence the work so that approved data rules and definitions come before the work that depends on them. Master data and D365 FO alignment Define ownership, stewardship, and decision rights for customer, vendor, product, stock keeping unit (SKU), and pricing data. Define data quality (DQ) rules, a DQ scorecard, and controls for the creation of new products and SKUs. Align master data with D365. Support data cleansing, reconciliation, and cutover readiness. Data platform and Microsoft Fabric Define the business and governance requirements that the Fabric architecture must meet. These include data domains, source of truth, data freshness, data retention, and data access. Specify the rules for programs with more than one legal entity. Cover currency, fiscal calendar, intercompany transactions, and restatement. Review integrations from a business view. Write acceptance criteria for data products and pipelines. Analytics and Power BI Review all existing reports. For each report, decide to keep it, retire it, or rebuild it. Build the KPI catalog. Collect the reporting needs of the finance, supply chain, customer experience (CX), and warehouse teams. Write specifications and acceptance criteria for priority dashboards. Validate the delivery. Own the review after rollout. Process automation and controls Prioritize the manual tasks for automation with Power Automate and D365 workflows. Define business rules, approval controls, and acceptance criteria. These must keep the financial and master data controls. Validate the automations with business users. Set the baseline of benefits with the process owner. Qualifications Required At least 7 years of experience as a BA on enterprise resource planning (ERP), data, or analytics programs. This includes hands-on experience with D365 FO. Experience as a leader of BAs or of an analysis workstream. Experience in client-facing work, including scope control and change control. Strong knowledge of supply chain: procurement, sales, inventory, warehouse, and master data. Working knowledge of data platforms, business intelligence (BI), and process automation. The knowledge must be sufficient to specify and validate requirements. Experience in UAT. Experience as owner of a delivery backlog in Azure DevOps or Jira. Skill in Structured Query Language (SQL) and data profiling to validate requirements. Experience in programs with more than one legal entity and more than one country. Good to have Background in manufacturing, distribution, or consumer goods. A relevant certification, for example MB-330, PL-300, CBAP, or DP-600. Experience in data governance and control.

title: Delivery Executive
description:
Job Summary 
 To ensure the timely and safe delivery and collection of IT products, hardware, networking equipment, documents, and other company materials to customers, vendors, project sites, and branch offices. The Delivery Executive is responsible for maintaining proper delivery records, handling materials carefully, and coordinating with internal departments to ensure smooth logistics operations. Company: Vatanix Technologies Private Limited Department: Logistics / Operations Designation: Delivery Executive Reporting To: Logistics Manager / Logistics In-Charge 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Deliver IT products, hardware, networking equipment, and other materials to customers and project locations. Ensure timely delivery as per the assigned schedule. Collect materials from vendors, suppliers, customers, and branch offices as instructed. Verify delivery addresses, contact details, and material quantities before dispatch. Obtain customer acknowledgement, signature, or proof of delivery. Ensure safe handling and transportation of company materials. Verify materials against delivery challans, invoices, and dispatch documents. Maintain proper delivery and collection records. Obtain signed delivery challans and submit them to the concerned department. Report damaged, missing, or incorrect materials immediately. Ensure proper documentation for material movement between branches and project sites. Coordinate with the Logistics, Purchase, Accounts, Sales, and Service departments. Follow delivery instructions from the Logistics In-Charge. Update delivery status regularly with the concerned team. Coordinate with customers and vendors regarding delivery schedules. Support urgent material movements and project-related requirements. Maintain the assigned vehicle in good condition, if applicable. Check fuel, vehicle condition, and essential documents before travel. Follow traffic rules and company transportation policies. Maintain travel logs, fuel bills, and other expense records. Report vehicle maintenance requirements and breakdowns immediately. Assist with office-to-office material transfers. Support warehouse and stock movement activities whenever required. Maintain discipline, punctuality, and professional behaviour. Handle company materials and customer property responsibly. Perform other logistics-related duties assigned by the reporting manager. 
 
 Qualifications / Requirements 
 Minimum 10th / 12th qualification. Valid two-wheeler or four-wheeler driving licence, as applicable. Minimum 1 2 years of experience in delivery, logistics, or courier operations preferred. Knowledge of local routes and locations. Basic communication skills in Tamil and English. Ability to handle IT hardware and networking equipment carefully. Basic knowledge of delivery challans and invoices. Responsible, punctual, and trustworthy. 
 
 Job Expectations 
 Must be available for local and occasional outstation deliveries. Must follow the daily delivery schedule and reporting instructions. Must maintain confidentiality of company and customer information. Must ensure that no materials are delivered without proper authorization. Must submit all delivery documents and expenses on time.

title: Manager/Sr Manager - RCM
description:
Role Overview The Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end US Behavioral Health RCM operations, with a strong focus on inpatient and residential treatment facilities. The ideal candidate must have practical experience in Behavioral Health billing, facility billing, Utilization Review (UR), authorization management, claims processing, AR follow-up, denial resolution and payer coordination. The candidate will act as the primary operational bridge between US-based clients, internal management and offshore delivery teams. Key Responsibilities 1. Behavioral Health RCM Operations Manage end-to-end RCM operations for US-based Behavioral Health and Substance Use Disorder facilities. Oversee inpatient, residential, detoxification and rehabilitation billing workflows. Manage institutional/facility claims, including UB-04 and 837I. Ensure accurate charge entry, claim submission, payment posting, reconciliation and AR follow-up. Establish operational workflows, SOPs, quality checkpoints and productivity benchmarks. Manage payer-specific billing requirements and timely filing compliance. 2. Utilization Review & Authorization Management Oversee initial authorization, concurrent review and continued-stay authorization workflows. Monitor authorization days against patient admission, treatment and discharge dates. Ensure timely submission of clinical documentation to insurance payers. Coordinate with US-based clinical teams for medical necessity documentation and payer requests. Monitor authorization approvals, partial approvals, denials and escalation timelines. Coordinate peer-to-peer reviews and clinical appeals with appropriately qualified clinical professionals. Ensure authorization gaps and non-covered days are escalated promptly. 3. Accounts Receivable & Denial Management Monitor outstanding AR, aging buckets and collection performance. Drive resolution of underpayments, rejected claims and payer denials. Manage medical necessity, authorization, eligibility and contractual denial categories. Establish payer-wise escalation mechanisms and appeal tracking. Improve first-pass claim acceptance and reduce avoidable denials. Monitor collection performance and ensure adherence to client SLAs. 4. Client Management & Stakeholder Coordination Act as the primary offshore operational contact for US-based clients. Participate in client meetings, operational reviews and performance discussions. Communicate operational challenges, risks, action plans and improvement opportunities. Build strong professional relationships with client stakeholders. Ensure timely resolution of escalations and maintain client confidence. Support new client onboarding, transition, knowledge transfer and stabilization. 5. Team Leadership & Performance Management Build, lead and develop Behavioral Health RCM teams. Define team KPIs, KRAs, productivity targets and quality benchmarks. Monitor daily production, accuracy, attendance and SLA adherence. Conduct performance reviews, coaching and knowledge-sharing sessions. Identify training gaps and establish continuous improvement programs. Develop backup resources and succession plans for critical processes. 6. Quality, Compliance & Process Excellence Ensure adherence to HIPAA requirements, information security policies and client-specific compliance standards. Establish internal audits for billing, authorization, coding coordination and AR processes. Maintain process documentation, SOPs and audit trails. Monitor operational risks and implement corrective and preventive actions. Ensure appropriate access controls and secure handling of Protected Health Information (PHI). 7. Reporting & Business Performance Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational MIS. Track key operational metrics, including: Net collection performance Days in AR AR aging First-pass claim acceptance rate Denial rate and denial resolution rate Authorization turnaround time Continued-stay approval rate Billing accuracy and productivity SLA compliance Team utilization and quality scores Present operational performance, risks and improvement plans to senior management. Mandatory Technical Requirements 8+ years of experience in US Healthcare RCM. Minimum 35 years of direct Behavioral Health RCM exposure, preferably in inpatient/residential treatment. Strong understanding of Substance Use Disorder, detoxification and residential treatment billing. Practical knowledge of UB-04, CMS-1450 and 837I institutional claims. Experience with Utilization Review, prior authorization and continued-stay authorization. Strong knowledge of medical necessity, payer requirements and denial management. Experience managing US commercial insurance and Medicaid billing workflows. Working knowledge of Kipu EMR or other Behavioral Health EHR/EMR platforms. Experience handling offshore operations and US client coordination. Strong leadership, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Kipu, Alleva, Ritten or comparable Behavioral Health platforms. Exposure to inpatient detoxification, rehabilitation and residential SUD facilities. Experience in out-of-network billing and collection workflows. Knowledge of PHP and IOP billing. Experience in operational transition, process migration and client onboarding. Candidate Profile We are looking for a proactive, accountable and solution-oriented professional who can independently manage Behavioral Health RCM operations. The candidate must be capable of handling client conversations, operational escalations, team performance and revenue cycle challenges without depending entirely on senior management. This is a hands-on leadership position requiring strong operational ownership and the ability to build and scale a specialized Behavioral Health RCM delivery team.

title: Urgent Opening For Senior Visa Executive(Chennai/Pune)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE We are launching a new visa and travel documentation service for travellers based in Kuwait, delivered in partnership with an established Kuwait travel agency. You will be the first hire on this desk: you will prepare and manage visa applications end to end, from checking what each traveller needs to booking their appointment and tracking the result. Applicants hold many different passports, including Kuwaiti, Indian, other South Asian, Arab and other expatriate nationalities, and apply through embassies and visa application centres in Kuwait. The core skill is working out exactly what each case requires, not following a single checklist. The desk covers every destination and visa category that travellers can apply for from Kuwait : visit and tourist, business, student, work, family and dependant, and transit visas, for destinations such as the UK, the US, the Schengen Area, Canada, Australia, the other Gulf states and Asia. Because this is a new desk, you will help shape how it works, and the role will grow with the volume. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Receive new cases from our partner agency and confirm each traveller's nationality, destination, travel dates and purpose. Determine visa requirements for each case (whether a visa is needed, which category and which documents) and send the traveller a tailored checklist. Review documents such as passports, bank statements, employment and salary letters, bookings and invitations; flag gaps or risks before submission. Complete online and paper applications accurately for any destination, such as UK visa forms, the US DS-160 and Schengen, Canadian and Australian applications. Book and manage appointments at embassies and visa application centres in Kuwait, and brief travellers on their in-person biometrics visit. Draft supporting documents: cover letters, day-by-day travel itineraries and invitation-letter templates. Track every application in a shared case log and keep the partner agency and management informed of status, delays and outcomes. Keep up to date with changes in visa rules, fees and appointment procedures, and maintain internal checklists for each destination and nationality. Refer any case that needs licensed immigration advice in the destination country to a qualified, regulated adviser. Handle all client documents and personal data in strict confidence, following iMarque's data-security procedures. 
 REQUIREMENTS At least 3 years of hands-on visa processing at a visa consultancy, travel agency or travel management company (TMC); more experience is welcome. Proven experience preparing visa applications for multiple destinations, including at least the UK, the US and the Schengen Area. Experience across several visa categories (visit, business, student, work and family), and an understanding of how requirements differ by nationality and country of residence. Quick to learn a new country's process from official sources. Excellent written English; able to draft clear, professional cover letters. Strong attention to detail: an error on a form can mean a refusal. Organised and comfortable managing many cases at once in Excel or Google Sheets. Comfortable working a shift aligned to Kuwait business hours. Willing to undergo a background verification. 
 NICE TO HAVE Experience with applications filed from Kuwait or another Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) country. Experience with online portals of visa application centres. Experience with Canada, Australia, GCC or East Asian visa processes. Hindi, Arabic, Malayalam or Urdu. 
 WHAT WE OFFER Competitive salary based on experience. The chance to build a new service line from the ground up. A growth path to lead the visa desk as the team expands. 
 HOW TO APPLY We are hiring immediately; immediate joiners, or candidates with a notice period of 30 days or less, are preferred. Send your CV to [Application email] with the subject line Senior Visa Executive – [Your Name]” . In a few lines, tell us which countries' visas you have handled and roughly how many applications you processed per month in your last role.

Key Skills: Operations,Processing,Filing,Visa Filing,Visa processing,Senior,Counselling,Process
