title: General Manager Purchase
description:
Hiring: General Manager Purchase Industry: Construction / Real Estate / Location: Hyderabad. Experience: 12–18 Years Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and strategic General Manager – Purchase to lead and manage the company's procurement and purchasing operations. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring timely procurement of construction materials, equipment, machinery and services at competitive prices while maintaining quality standards and optimizing procurement costs. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in construction procurement, vendor development, contract negotiations, inventory management and supply chain operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Procurement Strategy & Planning 
 Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with project requirements and organizational objectives. Plan and oversee procurement of construction materials, equipment, machinery and services. Ensure timely availability of materials for ongoing and upcoming projects. Coordinate with Project Managers, Planning and Engineering teams to understand material requirements. Establish procurement budgets and cost-saving initiatives. 2. Vendor & Supplier Management 
 Identify, evaluate and develop reliable vendors, suppliers and manufacturers. Establish long-term relationships with key suppliers. Conduct vendor assessments based on quality, pricing, delivery timelines and service. Negotiate commercial terms, payment conditions and delivery schedules. Monitor vendor performance and ensure timely supply of materials. 3. Cost Control & Commercial Negotiations 
 Negotiate competitive prices and favourable commercial terms. Analyse market rates and maintain updated material price databases. Implement cost-control measures without compromising quality. Evaluate quotations, comparative statements and purchase proposals. Identify opportunities for bulk purchasing and procurement savings. 4. Construction Material Procurement 
 Oversee procurement of major construction materials, including: Cement, steel and TMT bars. Sand, aggregates and ready-mix concrete. Bricks, blocks and construction chemicals. Electrical and plumbing materials. Flooring, tiles, sanitaryware and finishing materials. Structural steel, equipment and machinery. Ensure materials meet approved technical specifications and quality standards. Coordinate with site teams to avoid material shortages and project delays. 5. Purchase Operations & Documentation 
 Supervise the complete purchase cycle, from purchase requisitions to purchase order issuance. Review and approve purchase orders as per the company's delegation of authority. Ensure proper documentation of quotations, comparative statements, purchase orders and invoices. Monitor pending orders, delivery schedules and material dispatches. Ensure transparency and compliance with procurement policies. 6. Inventory & Stores Coordination 
 Coordinate with site stores and inventory teams to monitor stock levels. Ensure proper material planning and inventory control. Avoid excess purchasing, material wastage and unnecessary stock accumulation. Monitor material receipts, quality checks and stock reconciliation. Establish effective inventory management procedures. 7. Logistics & Supply Chain Management 
 Ensure timely transportation and delivery of materials to construction sites. Coordinate with vendors, transporters and logistics partners. Resolve supply chain issues and material delivery delays. Develop alternative sourcing strategies to minimize procurement risks. 8. Team Management & Interdepartmental Coordination 
 Lead and manage the purchase and procurement team. Assign responsibilities and monitor individual and departmental performance. Coordinate with Project Execution, Engineering, Finance, Accounts, Planning and Stores departments. Review procurement performance and provide regular updates to senior management. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or Business Administration. MBA in Supply Chain Management / Materials Management will be an added advantage. 12–18 years of experience in procurement and purchase operations, preferably in construction or infrastructure. Strong knowledge of construction materials, market rates and supplier networks. Proven experience in vendor development, commercial negotiations and cost optimization. Experience handling large-scale procurement for multiple construction projects. Knowledge of ERP systems, MS Excel and procurement reporting. Strong leadership, analytical and negotiation skills. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Procurement cost savings and budget optimization. Timely material availability at project sites. Vendor performance and delivery efficiency. Purchase order processing turnaround time. Material quality and specification compliance. Inventory optimization and reduction of material wastage. Procurement budget adherence. Supplier relationship management and payment coordination.

Key Skills: Materials,Procurement,Management,Planning,General,Purchase,Purchase management,Material procurement

title: Inventory Manager
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Assistant Manager Inventory & Warehouse Operations to manage inventory and warehouse activities at our food manufacturing facility. The ideal candidate should have 36 years of relevant experience in inventory or store management, preferably in the chocolate, confectionery, FMCG, or food manufacturing industry. The candidate should possess strong stock management abilities, advanced knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets, and good communication and coordination skills. 
 Key Responsibilities A. Inventory & Stock Management Manage daily inventory of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Maintain accurate stock records, inventory registers, and stock movement reports. Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment to avoid stock shortages. Track batch numbers, manufacturing dates, and expiry dates. Monitor incoming and outgoing materials with proper documentation. Ensure accurate recording of all stock transactions. B. Warehouse & Store Operations Ensure proper storage, handling, labelling, and identification of materials. Implement and monitor FIFO (First In, First Out) and FEFO (First Expiry, First Out)systems. Maintain proper warehouse organisation and optimise storage space. Ensure materials are stored as per applicable food safety and quality standards. Monitor material wastage, damages, and inventory losses. Ensure proper segregation and identification of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. 
 C. Stock Auditing & Reporting Conduct regular physical stock verification and inventory audits. Reconcile physical stock with system records and resolve discrepancies. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory MIS reports. Maintain proper documentation for all inventory transactions. Monitor stock ageing, slow-moving, and non-moving inventory. Analyse stock consumption and identify opportunities to improve inventory control. 
 D. Coordination & Operations Coordinate with Purchase, Production, and Quality teams to ensure smooth inventory operations. Ensure timely availability of materials as per production requirements. Follow up on pending material receipts and stock discrepancies. Coordinate material planning and replenishment requirements with the concerned departments. Support management in inventory planning and process improvements. 
 4. Required Skills & Qualifications Graduate in any discipline; preferably in Commerce, Supply Chain Management, or Operations. 3–6 years of relevant experience in Inventory Management, Store Management, or Warehouse Operations. Advanced knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets. Strong understanding of inventory control and warehouse management. Knowledge of FIFO/FEFO, stock reconciliation, and batch tracking. Experience in preparing inventory MIS reports and analysing stock data. Good communication and coordination skills. Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to independently manage inventory and ensure stock accuracy. 
 5. Preferred Industry Experience Candidates with experience in the following industries will be preferred: Chocolate and Confectionery Manufacturing FMCG Food & Beverage Manufacturing Food Processing Industry 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Maintaining high inventory accuracy and stock reconciliation. Minimising material wastage and inventory losses. Ensuring timely availability of raw materials and packaging materials. Proper implementation of FIFO/FEFO systems. Preventing stock shortages and minimising stock discrepancies. description:

The role will drive strategic sourcing initiatives while maintaining quality, service, and governance standards. 
 Key Responsibilities : Develop and implement sourcing strategies aligned with business requirements, changing market conditions, new business opportunities and cost optimisation objectives. Manage RFQs, quotation analysis, commercial comparisons, price bench-marking, negotiations and supplier finalisation to secure competitive pricing and favourable commercial terms. Evaluate supplier proposals based on pricing, specifications, quality, capacity, lead times, payment terms, freight and delivery schedules; prepare commercial comparison statements, document supplier selection justifications, and obtain approvals as per the applicable authority matrix. Manage procurement of marketing and promotional materials, including Glass-in-Pack (GIP), Glass-on-Pack (GOP), Value-Added Packs (VAP), glassware, promotional gifts, consumer promotion materials, POSM, signage, retail visibility materials, merchandise, white goods and fabrication requirements. Collaborate with Marketing, Trade Marketing, Regional Trade Marketing Managers, Sales, Operations, Quality, Finance and Supply Chain teams to understand requirements, specifications, artwork, quantities, budgets, samples, delivery locations and timelines. Support forecasting, material planning and volume analysis to align procurement and delivery schedules with campaign requirements, business priorities and material availability. Identify, evaluate, onboard and develop suppliers in coordination with relevant internal teams, including vendor registration and verification of mandatory documentation. Monitor supplier performance against agreed cost, quality, production capacity and delivery requirements; resolve commercial, quality and supply-related issues and support supplier diversity initiatives. Track orders from production through dispatch and delivery, expedite urgent requirements, resolve supply or transportation constraints and communicate delivery updates, delays and potential risks to stakeholders. Support material resource planning through SAP and other reporting tools, monitor material availability and inventory levels and coordinate with relevant teams to maintain inventory accuracy, improve inventory turns, reduce waste and minimise obsolete stock and inventory liabilities. Prepare and maintain procurement MIS covering sourcing activities, commercial evaluations, pending orders, supplier performance, delivery status and other relevant procurement metrics. Coordinate with Finance and relevant teams on goods receipt documentation, invoice verification and booking, payment follow-ups, agreed payment terms and advance payment approvals. title: Wholesale Credit Risk Associate
description:
As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorganChase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgment to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class. In this role, you will be a key member of the iSPRESO Product Team within Wholesale Credit Risk Product, owning product workstreams end to end and partnering with credit risk teams, technology, data and AI partners, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders. You will help onboard portfolios, deliver new product features, and keep the financial data that credit monitoring, grading, and analytics depend on accurate and reliable. As a Risk Associate within Risk Management and Compliance , you will be a key member of a credit risk product team owning product workstreams end to end, from requirements through production. You will partner with credit risk teams, technology partners, data partners, and subject matter experts to onboard portfolios and deliver new product features. You will help ensure the financial data used for credit monitoring, grading, and analytics is accurate and reliable. You will use data analysis and controls to identify issues early and support resolution through to closure. You will communicate clearly with stakeholders through demos, working sessions, and status updates. Job responsibilities Own product workstreams end to end, from requirements through build, user acceptance testing, release, and production support Gather requirements from credit risk stakeholders and write clear user stories with acceptance criteria, user interface mockups, and test data Build and maintain financial data models and templates for portfolios (line items, formulas, validations), and onboard new portfolios with credit risk users and subject matter experts Source, map, and onboard vendor and market data and define how it flows into the product and to downstream consumers Define requirements for application programming interfaces, event feeds, and data lake views that downstream monitoring, grading, and analytics teams rely on, and validate what they receive Use SQL and Python to analyze data, reconcile product outputs against source systems and application programming interfaces, and set up controls that catch issues before users see them Apply large language model and artificial intelligence capabilities to product use cases, including large language model-based financial spreading, and use artificial intelligence tools to automate analysis, testing, and documentation Plan and run user acceptance testing with documented test evidence; triage production issues and ServiceNow tickets, drive root-cause analysis with technology, and see fixes through to closure Define and track product metrics and key performance indicators, deliver recurring and ad hoc reporting, and use the results to inform prioritization Run product demos, working group, and feedback sessions with stakeholders, and support release coordination and status communication Partner with solution architects and technologists on technical approaches, and help onboard and mentor new joiners and interns Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Bachelor s Degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field 3+ years of relevant work experience in credit risk, financial data, product, business analysis, or a related capacity Understanding of financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, trailing twelve month and year to date periods) and their relevance for credit and banking use cases Hands-on SQL and Python (or similar) for analysis, mapping, and reconciliation of large datasets Experience writing clear requirements (user stories, acceptance criteria) and testing delivered features Strong, clear, and concise written and verbal communication skills, including summarizing analysis for senior stakeholders Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities under tight deadlines Proven ability to collaborate and build strong partnerships across business, technology, and data teams in a matrix organization Ownership mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a proven ability to learn quickly Experience using data and metrics to drive decisions Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience with data vendors and their application programming interfaces or feeds Familiarity with application programming interfaces, event streaming (for example Kafka), and data platforms (Oracle, data lakes, Databricks, or Dremio) Prior experience in implementation of artificial intelligence or large language model-based solutions or using artificial intelligence tools to automate work Experience creating user interface mockups and working with technology and user experience design colleagues on technical designs Experience with Agile delivery using JIRA and Confluence Exposure to credit monitoring, risk grading, or financial spreading processes

title: Inventory Manager
description:
A. SKU & Inventory Management Create, maintain and regularly update the master list of all SKUs, including product codes, descriptions, pack sizes, units of measurement and applicable pricing details. Track SKU-wise stock on a daily basis, including opening stock, inward receipts, outward movement, sales, returns, damages and closing stock. Maintain accurate inventory records in the ERP, inventory software or approved Excel trackers. Monitor minimum, maximum and reorder levels; highlight low-stock, excess-stock, non-moving and near-expiry inventory wherever applicable. Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile variances with system records; investigate and report discrepancies. Ensure proper batch / lot number, manufacturing date, expiry date and stock rotation records wherever applicable. B. Order Processing & Sales Coordination Receive and verify sales orders from the sales team, distributors, franchisees and other customers. Check SKU availability, quantities, pricing, discounts and order terms before processing orders. Prepare sales orders, pick lists and dispatch instructions accurately and within defined timelines. Coordinate with the warehouse and dispatch team to ensure correct picking, packing and timely shipment. Track pending, partially fulfilled and completed orders and proactively communicate delays or stock shortages to concerned teams. Coordinate with the sales team for order amendments, cancellations, returns and replacement requests. C. Sales Invoice & Documentation Prepare sales invoices and related documents based on approved orders and company billing procedures. Verify customer details, GSTIN, billing and shipping addresses, SKU descriptions, HSN codes, quantities, rates, discounts, taxes and invoice totals before release. Ensure invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills and other applicable dispatch documents are prepared in coordination with the Accounts team. Maintain an organised record of sales orders, invoices, credit notes, debit notes, delivery documents and returns. Share invoice copies and order status updates with the relevant sales, accounts, dispatch and customer teams. Escalate pricing, tax, credit-limit or customer-master discrepancies for approval before invoicing. D. Reporting & Reconciliation Prepare daily and periodic reports covering SKU-wise stock, stock ageing, inward and outward movement, order status, sales invoicing and pending dispatches. Reconcile stock records with sales invoices, dispatch records, purchase receipts and physical stock. Identify fast-moving, slow-moving and non-moving SKUs and share actionable insights with management. Maintain records of stock transfers between warehouses, locations or franchisee points, supported by approved documentation. Submit accurate inventory and order reports within agreed timelines. E. Process, Controls & Coordination Ensure inventory transactions are recorded promptly and supported by appropriate documents and approvals. Follow company procedures for stock receipt, storage, issue, transfer, returns, damage and write-offs. Coordinate with Purchase, Sales, Accounts, Warehouse, Logistics and Franchise Operations teams. Support internal and statutory audits by providing accurate stock registers, invoices and supporting records. Suggest improvements to inventory controls, order processing, billing accuracy and reporting processes. 
 Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of inventory management, SKU tracking and stock reconciliation. Working knowledge of sales order processing, invoicing and dispatch documentation. Proficiency in MS Excel; experience with ERP, inventory or billing software is preferred. Basic understanding of GST invoicing, HSN codes and e-way bill processes in India. High attention to detail, numerical accuracy and record-keeping discipline. Good coordination, communication, follow-up and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple orders and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Qualification & Experience Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field preferred. Typically 25 years of experience in inventory, warehouse operations, order processing or billing; relevant experience may be considered in place of formal qualification. Experience in FMCG, beverages, distribution or multi-SKU businesses will be an added advantage. Shift Time – As per operational requirements rotational working hours will be applicable.

Key Skills: Inventory analysis,Inventory planning,Inventory,Material planning,Procurement,Inventory management,Inventory control,Analysis

title: Supply Chain / Procurement/Purchase Specialist
description:
About the Role: 
 We are hiring for a Purchasing & Planning Specialist to support the Aftermarket Parts business for a US-based client. This role focuses on procurement, inventory planning, and ensuring SKU availability while driving cost efficiency and customer satisfaction. 
 This role is with one of our US based clients. The client provides comprehensive systems and aftermarket support, including service, parts, and consumables. This position supports the Aftermarket Parts business and will be responsible for: 1. the daily purchasing and planning activities of service parts required to enable SKU availability (by defining and maintaining optimal inventory levels. 2. on-time order fulfillment (to both external and internal customers, on both stocking and non-stocking SKUs); 3. cost-effectiveness (required to drive both SKU and Customer level profitability). Successful candidates will demonstrate excellent analytical and communication skills, very high level of attention to detail, and the ability to react and multitask in a fast-paced and ever-changing business environment. 
 Job Duties: Place Purchase Orders and manage the entire procurement process from order placement to receipt, in order to ensure order accuracy, fulfillment timeliness and overall customer satisfaction. Approve Supplier invoices, while resolving non-conforming product and other issues in a timely manner to guarantee product availability and timely payment to suppliers. Analyze sales/usage trends and develop inventory replenishment strategies required to maintain appropriate inventory levels consistent with company-defined goals, while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory of Aftermarket Parts. Maintain accurate planning metrics on a SKU level basis including purchasing information, costing, lead times, MOQ/EOQ, and safety stock levels. Respond to customer (both external and internal) inquiries promptly and professionally. Act as a liaison between customers and suppliers to resolve procurement related issues. Identify risks to the supply chain, such as material shortages or production delays. Escalate all issues pertaining to supplier performance (Cost, Quality, and Availability) to the Supply Chain Management leadership team. Identify process improvement opportunities in Purchasing, Planning and Inventory Management and participate in the implementation of best practices and tools to streamline operations and drive efficiency improvements. 
 What You Need: Bachelors degree in any field. Minimum of 3 years experience in a Purchasing and/or in a Production Planning capacity, preferably in the Automotive Industry. Demonstrated practical knowledge of Purchasing principles and practices. Proficiency in Planning and Inventory Management principles and techniques. Strong negotiation skills and ability to build effective relationships with suppliers. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with superior attention to detail. Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional and courteous demeanor, and capable of successfully working cross-functionally. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in using computer systems, including: Past exposure to ERP systems and respective Procurement modulesNetSuite experience will be preferred. MS Office Suite (Word, Excel), namely in analyzing and manipulating data Adobe PDF Creator, namely in creating/manipulating PDFs Ability to work independently, as well as part of a broader team, with a proactive, positive, resourceful and efficient attitude. Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and willingness to take on additional responsibilities

description:
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory Job Title: Senior Manager – Direct Taxation Job Description We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager – Direct Tax to lead and manage direct tax matters, ensuring tax compliance, effective tax planning, and timely resolution of tax-related issues. The role will work closely with finance, business, legal, and senior management teams to provide strategic tax advice and ensure compliance with applicable tax laws and regulations. Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Direct Tax Compliance Oversee timely and accurate compliance with the Income-tax Act, 1961 and applicable rules, regulations, and notifications. Review and monitor corporate income-tax returns, tax computations, advance tax, self-assessment tax, and related filings. Ensure timely compliance with TDS/TCS provisions, including return filing, reconciliations, and correction statements. Review tax provisions and deferred tax calculations in coordination with the finance and accounting teams. Monitor tax notices, communications, and statutory requirements. 2. Tax Planning & Advisory Develop and implement effective tax-planning strategies aligned with business objectives. Provide tax advice on business transactions, contracts, investments, restructuring, financing, and other strategic initiatives. Evaluate tax implications of new business models, transactions, and commercial arrangements. Identify opportunities for tax optimisation while maintaining a strong focus on compliance and risk management. 3. Tax Assessments & Litigation Lead and coordinate income-tax assessments, audits, appeals, and other proceedings before tax authorities. Manage interactions with tax consultants, legal advisors, and external counsel. Review responses to tax notices, assessment orders, appeals, and submissions. Track tax litigation matters and assess potential tax exposures and contingent liabilities. Develop appropriate strategies for resolution of tax disputes. 4. Transfer Pricing & International Tax Coordinate with internal teams and external advisors on transfer-pricing compliance and documentation, where applicable. Review international transactions and assess implications under domestic tax laws and applicable tax treaties. Advise on withholding-tax implications for cross-border payments. Support matters relating to DTAA, PE exposure, withholding taxes, and international tax compliance . 5. Tax Risk Management Identify and evaluate direct tax risks across business functions. Establish appropriate tax controls and processes to minimise compliance risks. Monitor changes in tax laws, judicial precedents, CBDT circulars, notifications, and regulatory developments. Assess the impact of significant tax-law changes on the organisation and communicate key implications to stakeholders. 6. Stakeholder Management Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, HR, and business teams on tax-related matters. Present tax positions, risks, and recommendations to senior management. Manage relationships with tax consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities. Drive awareness of tax compliance requirements across relevant business teams. 7. Team Management Lead, mentor, and develop the direct-tax team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor deliverables to ensure timely completion. Build strong tax processes, documentation standards, and knowledge within the team. Review the quality and accuracy of work performed by team members and external advisors. Key Deliverables / KPIs Timely and accurate completion of all direct-tax compliances. Effective management and reduction of tax risks and exposures. Successful management of assessments, audits, and litigation. Optimisation of the organisation’s effective tax rate within the applicable legal framework. Timely identification and implementation of tax-saving opportunities. Accurate tax provisioning and forecasting. Effective management of tax consultants and external advisors. Timely communication of changes in tax laws and their business impact. Strengthening of tax controls and processes. Qualifications CA (Chartered Accountant) – mandatory/preferred. Experience 8–12 years of relevant experience in direct taxation. Strong experience in corporate income tax, TDS, tax assessments, litigation, and tax planning. Exposure to international taxation and transfer pricing would be an advantage. Prior experience in managing a team is preferred. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Indian direct-tax laws and regulations. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong understanding of corporate tax compliance and tax accounting. Experience in handling tax authorities and assessments. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to interpret complex tax provisions and translate them into practical business advice. Strong attention to detail and ownership of deadlines. Good commercial and business understanding. Strong negotiation and presentation skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant tax/accounting systems

title: Assistant Manager Quality Control - Ahmedabad - NUA
description:
About the Role: Assistant Manager QC (Sanand/Ahmedabad location) is responsible for ensuring that every NUA napkin produced, and every raw and packaging material used to make it, meets defined quality, safety and regulatory standards. The role leads incoming raw material inspection, in-process checks and finished goods release, and drives corrective actions so that customers receive a safe, consistent and high-quality product. Key Responsibilities: 1. Raw Material Inspection & Control • Lead inspection and approval of all incoming raw materials, including fluff pulp, super absorbent polymer (SAP), nonwoven top sheet, acquisition distribution layer (ADL), PE back sheet, tissue/wrapping layers, hot-melt adhesive, release paper, wings and tapes, and inks. • Verify supplier Certificates of Analysis (COA) against specifications and perform independent verification testing (GSM, thickness, absorbency, moisture content, tensile strength, SAP absorption capacity, odour, visual defects, etc.). • Apply sampling plans (AQL / ISO 2859 or company-defined) and decide Accept / Reject / Hold for each lot. • Ensure proper material identification, traceability, quarantine and segregation of non-conforming material. • Inspect primary and secondary packaging materials (polybags, cartons, labels, shippers) for print accuracy, dimensions, seal strength and regulatory label content. • Support supplier qualification, audits, performance rating and corrective action follow-up (SCAR). 2. In-Process & Finished Product Quality • Supervise in-process checks on the napkin production line: dimensions, weight, core formation, adhesive application, sealing, wing placement, folding, wrapping and pack count. Conduct and review finished goods testing: absorbency, leakage/rewet, pad dimensions, adhesion strength, pH, visual and packaging integrity. • Authorise batch release or hold based on test results and batch documentation review. • Monitor line deviations, perform root-cause analysis and verify implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). • Manage retained samples and shelf-life/stability observations. 3. Compliance & Documentation • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and regulations, such as BIS IS 5405 for sanitary napkins, ISO 9001, GMP/hygiene requirements and any applicable medical-device or cosmetic-adjacent regulations for the market. • Maintain and update SOPs, inspection plans, specifications, checklists and quality records. • Prepare for and support internal, customer, regulatory and third-party audits. • Maintain calibration schedules and records for all lab and inspection equipment. 4. Customer Complaints & Continuous Improvement • Investigate market and customer complaints (leakage, odour, adhesion, skin irritation, packaging defects) and issue root-cause reports. • Track quality KPIs such as incoming rejection rate, in-process defect rate, complaint rate (PPM) and batch release turnaround; present monthly MIS to management. • Drive improvement initiatives using 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto, SPC, Kaizen and Six Sigma tools. • Collaborate with R&D, Production, Procurement and Supply Chain on new material trials and product changes. 5. Team Leadership • Supervise, train and evaluate QC inspectors and lab staff; allocate shifts and workload. • Train production and warehouse teams on quality standards, hygiene and defect recognition. • Foster a quality-first, hygiene-conscious culture on the shop floor. • Lead the QC team end to end: set daily and weekly targets, assign inspection and lab tasks across shifts, and review the quality of their work and records. • Handle team performance, including goal setting, appraisals, skill-gap identification, discipline and motivation; recommend hiring, promotions and training needs. • Build a capable second line by cross-training inspectors on all material types and tests, and delegate responsibly in your absence. • Resolve conflicts between QC and Production or Warehouse on accept/reject decisions, escalating to the Manager when needed. 6. Supplier Audits & Independent Site Visits • Plan and independently conduct on-site audits of raw and packaging material suppliers (pulp, SAP, nonwoven, PE film, adhesive, release paper, packaging), covering process control, hygiene, in-house testing, storage and traceability. • Visit supplier facilities without needing a supervisor to accompany you, make audit-based approval or rejection recommendations, and present findings to management. • Use structured audit checklists and scoring; issue audit reports and SCARs, and follow up on corrective actions to closure. Carry out pre-shipment or first-lot inspections at supplier locations when required, and verify the supplier's sampling, testing and batch records. • Maintain the approved supplier list, audit calendar and supplier performance ratings; propose supplier development or alternate sourcing where quality is a concern. • Conduct internal audits of production, warehouse and QC areas, and support customer and regulatory audits. Preferred Qualifications: 1. Education B.Sc. / M.Sc. (Chemistry, Textile, Polymer, Paper Technology, Microbiology) or B.E./B.Tech (Chemical, Textile, Polymer, Packaging, Industrial) or equivalent. 2. Experience 5 to 8 years in Quality Control within hygiene products (sanitary napkins, diapers, tissues), nonwovens, FMCG or packaging manufacturing. At least 2 to 3 years in raw material and incoming inspection and in a supervisory role. 3. Certifi cations (preferred) ISO 9001 Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor Six Sigma Green Belt Training in GMP, HACCP or cleanroom/hygiene practices

Key Skills: Auditing,Quality management,Inspection,Supplier,Quality,QC,Assistance,QC inspection

description:
ob Title: Customer Support Manager Location: Sitra, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu Experience: 5+ years Industry: Any Industry Shift: Day Shift Company website: www.prominance.com | www.homworks.com Job Summary We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Customer Support Manager to lead our call center operations in Coimbatore. This pivotal senior role involves managing a team of 25 Customer Support Executives and carrying the full responsibility for the call center's performance. A key function will be overseeing the intake, qualification, and follow-up on all leads generated through social media and digital platforms for both Prominance and Homworks brands. Key Responsibilities 1. Team Leadership & Management Lead a team of 25 Customer Support Executives, providing coaching, mentorship, and performance feedback to ensure a high-performing and motivated team. Conduct regular team meetings, training sessions, and one-on-one reviews. Manage scheduling and resource allocation, ensuring adequate coverage, including being open to working on weekends as per operational requirements. 2. Call Center Performance & Operations Full responsibility for the entire call center's operational performance, ensuring all service level agreements (SLAs) and quality metrics are met or exceeded. Monitor, analyze, and report on critical KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) such as Average Handle Time (AHT), First Call Resolution (FCR), Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), and call quality scores. Resolve escalated customer issues, particularly those related to the UPVC doors/windows and home interior. 3. Process Improvement & Reporting Identify bottlenecks and implement strategies to improve support processes and systems for greater efficiency and customer satisfaction. Prepare detailed weekly and monthly performance reports for senior management, highlighting team achievements, challenges, and necessary resource forecasts. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, particularly Sales, Manufacturing, and Installation, to streamline issue resolution and feedback loops. 4. Digital Lead Management & Nurturing Lead Handling Ownership: Be the primary owner for the swift intake and initial qualification of all customer leads generated through social media platforms (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) and other digital campaigns. Lead-to-Sales Coordination: Establish and enforce a strict SLA for the team's follow-up on these marketing leads, ensuring timely communication and proper handoff of qualified leads to the Sales team. Data Integrity: Track and report on the conversion metrics specifically for social media leads, analyzing performance from lead source to final sale. Requirements Bachelors degree required. 5+ years in customer support, with a minimum of 2+ years in a high-volume leadership role managing a team of 15+ executives. Demonstrated knowledge of the manufacturing or construction industry is preferred. Strong communication, coaching, and people management skills. Experience in administering and leveraging CRM tools for tracking and reporting. Benefits Competitive salary, incentives, health insurance and career growth opportunities. title: HR Executive : Work From Home : Grad Freshers : Females : Apply Now
description:
Outpace Consulting is looking for dynamic, confident and result-driven HR Recruiters with experience in recruitment or candidate calling. 
This opportunity is ideal for individuals who enjoy interacting with people, are confident on calls, and have the ability to engage, convince and close candidates. 
 Eligibility & Requirements 
 Graduate in any stream. Minimum 3 months of experience in Recruitment / Candidate Calling. Internship or full-time job experience - both are considered. Strong communication skills in Hindi with basic conversational English. Confident and comfortable with extensive calling and candidate interaction. Good interpersonal, convincing and follow-up skills. Target-oriented and result-driven approach. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Comfortable working with daily calling and hiring targets. Own laptop and stable internet connection are mandatory. 
 Who Are We Looking For? 
 Enjoys talking to and interacting with people. Has a natural flair for calling and candidate engagement. Can confidently explain opportunities and handle candidate objections. Is proactive, disciplined and self-driven. Can take ownership of assigned hiring requirements. Is comfortable working in a performance-driven environment. Is serious about building a long-term career in recruitment. 
 Role Overview 
As an HR Recruiter, you will manage the recruitment cycle from candidate sourcing and screening to interview coordination, follow-ups, selection and joining closure across multiple hiring requirements. 
 A. Candidate Sourcing & Screening 
 Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, social media, WhatsApp groups, references and other relevant channels. Understand Job Descriptions and hiring requirements. Screen candidates based on experience, eligibility and role requirements. Assess candidates' communication skills and overall suitability. Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline. 
 B. Candidate Calling & Engagement 
 Connect with shortlisted candidates through outbound calls. Explain the job profile, salary, location, shifts, eligibility and selection process. Understand candidate expectations and career requirements. Handle basic queries and objections professionally. Generate candidate interest and drive them towards interviews. 
 C. Interview Coordination & Closure 
 Schedule and coordinate candidate interviews. Maintain regular follow-ups before interviews. Ensure strong interview show-up rates. Track candidate progress through different interview stages. Follow up with selected candidates until joining. Focus on improving selection-to-joining conversion. 
 D. Candidate Management 
 Build professional relationships with candidates. Keep candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process. Provide timely interview and selection updates. Handle candidate dropouts and follow-up requirements. Maintain an organized pipeline of active candidates. 
 E. MIS & Performance Reporting 
 Maintain daily recruitment trackers and MIS. Track calls, screenings, lineups, interviews, selections and joinings. Share daily performance updates with the Team Lead. Work towards assigned recruitment targets and KPIs. 
 Why Join Outpace Consulting? 
 100% Work From Home flexibility. Performance-driven growth opportunities. Hands-on exposure to live recruitment. Opportunity to work across multiple hiring requirements. Strong exposure to candidate sourcing, calling and closure. Fast-paced and learning-oriented work environment. Opportunity to develop practical recruitment and candidate-management skills. 
 This Role Is For You If... 
 You enjoy calling, interacting with people, convincing candidates and achieving hiring targets - and want to build a serious career in recruitment. 
 How to Apply 
 Please apply through Naukri.com. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our recruitment team.

title: Senior Application Engineer(Software Licensing & Protection Solutions)
description:
Senior Application Engineer (Software Licensing & Protection Solutions) (2 Positions) Location : Pune/Bengaluru (Hybrid) About our Client: A global leader in software protection and licensing solutions, serving over 5,000 companies worldwide through its flagship technology platform. Established its presence in India in Q2 2024 through strategic partnerships and set up a dedicated legal entity in Q2 2026 to tap into India's rapidly expanding software licensing market. With a strong focus on building dedicated technical services capabilities, the organisation views this role as a strategic investment, central to strengthening its market presence and differentiating its offerings in India. Position Summary We are seeking a Senior Application Engineer to lead the end-to-end technical lifecycle, from pre-sales consulting to post-sales implementation and customer success, for software protection and licensing solutions across India. This hands-on role involves: Designing and presenting technical solutions to ISVs, OEMs and device manufacturers. Managing POCs, implementations and integrations across diverse technology platforms. Developing use cases and technical enablement programs for partners and system integrators. Translating customer requirements into scalable technical solutions. You will work closely with regional sales teams, strategic partners and the global headquarters to build and strengthen India's technical services capabilities. Travel: 3050% domestic travel. Core Responsibilities 1. Pre-Sales Technical Consulting & Solution Architecture (50%) Engage with ISVs, OEMs and enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business challenges. Design and recommend software protection and licensing solutions, including licensing models and deployment architectures. Lead POCs, technical demonstrations and pilot implementations across Windows, Linux, embedded and cloud environments. Prepare technical proposals, implementation estimates, ROI/TCO assessments and solution documentation. 2. Implementation & Technical Delivery (20%) Own customer onboarding, solution deployment, SDK/API integrations and go-live activities. Execute installations, integrations, migrations, upgrades and licensing model transitions. Ensure seamless implementation across diverse technology platforms and troubleshoot complex technical issues. 3. Technical Support & Customer Success (25%) Provide first-level technical support to Indian customers in coordination with the global support team. Resolve technical issues, manage customer escalations and maintain technical documentation and knowledge bases. Ensure effective support and long-term technical engagement with enterprise customers. 4. Partner & System Integrator Enablement (5%) Develop and deliver technical training, certification programs and integration workshops for partners and system integrators. Create technical enablement resources, including sample code, reference architectures and implementation guides. Develop industry-specific use cases across industrial automation, medical technology, automotive and engineering software. 5. Market Development & Global Collaboration Identify India-specific customer requirements, emerging applications, competitive trends and market opportunities. Collaborate with strategic partners, regional sales teams and global headquarters to develop scalable technical solutions. Provide market feedback to the global product team and contribute to technical webinars, workshops and customer case studies. Technical Expertise Must-Have Skills Strong hands-on programming experience in at least one technology stack: Application Development: .NET/C#, Java or Python. Systems/Embedded Development: C/C++, Embedded Linux or Firmware. Working knowledge of Windows and Linux environments; exposure to ARM, embedded systems or cloud platforms is an advantage. Experience in SDK/API integration, RESTful services and authentication/authorisation mechanisms. Preferred Skills Exposure to industrial manufacturing, automation, medical devices, automotive or engineering software. Understanding of cybersecurity principles, software security and compliance frameworks. Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of software licensing models, license servers, software protection and entitlement management. Consultative & Soft Skills Customer Engagement Strong consultative approach with the ability to understand customer needs, present technical solutions and engage confidently with developers, architects and business stakeholders. Excellent problem-solving skills with a practical, solution-oriented mindset. Communication & Collaboration Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (mandatory). Ability to prepare technical documentation, training materials and customer presentations. Strong coordination skills to work effectively with sales teams, partners and global stakeholders. Ownership & Adaptability Self-driven professional capable of working independently in a remote environment. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to establish processes and build technical capabilities from the ground up. Travel & Flexibility Willingness to travel 3050% across India for customer and partner engagements. Willingness to travel to Germany approximately once a year for training and team collaboration. Flexibility to coordinate with global teams across different time zones. Work Environment & Career Growth Work Environment Hybrid working model with home-office support. High-autonomy, performance-driven work culture. Opportunity to contribute directly to India's market strategy as an early member of the technical team. Scope to build and shape the technical services function and partner ecosystem in India. Career Growth Clear career progression opportunities towards Senior Solution Architect, Technical Lead or Regional Services Manager roles. Opportunity to take ownership of strategic technical initiatives and grow with the organisation's India operations. What We Offer Compensation & Incentives Competitive fixed compensation aligned with senior technical consulting roles. Attractive performance-based incentives linked to key deliverables, customer satisfaction, POC conversions and partner enablement. Professional Development Annual learning budget for professional certifications, industry conferences and advanced technical training. Opportunities to visit the Germany headquarters for specialised training and exposure to global product development and R&D. Opportunity to work with international teams and gain exposure to global technologies and best practices.

title: Plc And Control Engineer
description:
Job Title: Networks, Controls & Automation Engineer Location: Pune/Bangalore/Sahibabad Headcounts: 2 
 About Us Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com. 
 Job Overview: Experienced PLC and Field Communication Engineer with expertise in industrial automation, control systems, and communication networks. Skilled in PLC programming, commissioning, troubleshooting, and integrating field devices with SCADA/DCS systems. 
 Responsibilities: Design, develop, program, and commission PLC-based automation systems for power tools, lifting equipment, and industrial manufacturing applications. description:

This role helps strengthen proposal quality, support product selection and commercial strategy, maintain ISO and operational documentation, monitor performance metrics, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. Key Responsibilities Support Application Engineers in resolving internal nonconformance reports (NCRs) and maintaining accurate, current NCR records. Periodically review, update, and maintain Commercial Operations ISO documentation in DOCU Quest, including procedures, forms, templates, formats, flowcharts, and related controlled documents. Maintain quarterly reporting for Commercial Operations objectives and targets, ensuring timely, accurate performance visibility. Participate in internal and external ISO audits, including preparation, evidence gathering, follow-up actions, and continuous-improvement activities. Coordinate, consolidate, and update Daily Management Meeting metrics for the Commercial Operations team. Ensure adherence to Flowserve s Code of Business Conduct, ethics, harassment prevention, safety requirements, and Commercial Operations procedures. Provide high-level technical application support, including customer training, product presentations, new-hire onboarding, and application-engineering training to support appropriate pump and auxiliary-equipment selection. Support sales strategy development for OPEX and CAPEX opportunities through competitive hydraulic performance analysis, sourcing recommendations, scope-of-supply review, market-level pricing input, and end-user relationship leverage. Prepare for and participate in Weekly Project Review meetings with Commercial Operations leadership, Application Engineering, and Sales. Review proposals before submission and support Proposal Authorization Form approvals, including review of pricing makeup, market-level pricing, recommended fully burdened sales price, borderline hydraulic curves, and non-compliant pump selections. Develop strategic budgetary and firm proposals aligned with balanced-scorecard KPI requirements. Track hydraulic modifications for Coimbatore product lines in coordination with Product Management and Engineering. Capture frequently asked questions from the Commercial Operations team and maintain an accessible knowledge database. Deliver training for new Application Engineers on Commercial Operations processes, enquiry entry, product overviews, pump-selection guidance, applicable API requirements, and professional communication practices. Coordinate quarterly lessons-learned sharing with the CBE Commercial Operations team and the APME team. Maintain and update the CBE product-developed model list for SharePoint publication on a semiannual basis. Interpret monthly reporting results in collaboration with MT Product Management and meet Business Process Development analytics deadlines. Support decarbonization projects by understanding customer requirements, applications, and applicable Flowserve product solutions. Collaborate with Product Management, RD, Engineering, Supply Chain, and LPO factories to identify product-development opportunities that improve gross margin, competitiveness, and win rates. Participate in Kaizen and continuous-improvement events to improve Commercial Operations productivity. Qualifications and Competencies Strong technical understanding of pump applications, hydraulic performance, and auxiliary equipment selection. Working knowledge of commercial proposal development, pricing analysis, and project review processes. Familiarity with ISO quality-management systems, document control, audit participation, and corrective-action processes. Strong analytical, organizational, and reporting skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Sales, and Operations. Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical guidance for internal stakeholders. Demonstrated commitment to safety, ethics, quality, continuous improvement, and customer-focused execution.

title: Head Customer Service
description:
Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities 1. Customer Service Leadership & Strategy Lead the overall Customer Service function across Equity and Non-Equity business verticals. Develop and execute customer service strategies aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and growth priorities. Drive customer satisfaction, retention, engagement and service excellence; establish service standards, SLAs, KPIs and performance benchmarks. Lead large-scale, multi-location teams and build a high-performance, customer-first service culture. 2. Enterprise Transformation & Strategy Define and execute the Quality, Business Excellence (QBE) and Project Management strategy aligned with business priorities, technology roadmap and regulatory requirements. Lead enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve customer experience, operational productivity, process governance and cost efficiency. Partner with senior leadership and business heads to convert strategic priorities into actionable, measurable transformation programmes. 3. Transformation & Program Governance Lead strategic enterprise programmes through a structured Project Management Office (PMO). Establish clear outcomes, milestones, ownership, interdependencies, risks, benefits realisation and executive-level governance. Monitor project delivery through dashboards and structured reviews, ensuring timely execution and measurable business impact. 4. Quality & Process Governance Establish an enterprise Quality Governance Framework covering KPIs, controls, SOP adherence, process compliance and quality monitoring. Implement maker-checker controls, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), process audits and structured review mechanisms. Drive process standardisation, service quality and operational discipline across functions. 5. Operational Excellence & Process Improvement Drive Lean, Six Sigma, Business Process Management (BPM) and automation-led transformation. Reduce turnaround time (TAT), errors, process complexity and cost while improving productivity and capacity utilisation. Institutionalise structured problem-solving, continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making. 6. Digital & Intelligent Transformation Partner with Digital, IT and Analytics teams to conceptualise and deploy Straight Through Processing (STP), workflow automation, BPM, RPA, OCR, AI and data-driven decisioning. Drive digital adoption and technology-enabled service delivery, ensuring initiatives translate into measurable business outcomes. Leverage analytics and intelligent service tools to improve customer interactions, quality monitoring and operational insights. 7. Enterprise Platform Effectiveness Govern adoption, process integration and effectiveness of CRM, DMS, workflow management and other enterprise digital platforms. Work with technology teams to improve platform capabilities, process visibility, system integration and customer service delivery. 8. Customer Experience Excellence Establish CX frameworks covering NPS, CSAT, First Call Resolution (FCR), SLA/TAT, customer journey quality and service performance. Deliver a consistent, seamless omnichannel experience across voice, email, digital and other service channels. Analyse customer feedback, identify service gaps and implement initiatives to reduce repeat complaints and improve retention. 9. Equity & Non-Equity Product Service Oversee customer service across Equity, Derivatives (F&O), Currency, Commodity, Mutual Funds, IPOs, Bonds, PMS, AIF and other investment products. Ensure seamless support for trading, demat accounts, onboarding, funds transfer, settlement, payout, margin, holdings and portfolio-related queries. Manage complex escalations and coordinate with Operations, RMS, Technology, Compliance and Business teams. 10. Regulatory, Audit & Compliance Governance Ensure adherence to applicable SEBI, NSE, BSE, CDSL, NSDL and other regulatory requirements. Oversee investor grievances, SCORES complaints, exchange complaints and regulatory escalations, ensuring resolution within prescribed timelines. Drive timely closure and sustainable CAPA for Internal Audit, Regulatory and Compliance observations; strengthen preventive controls.

title: Manager- ETS (Employee Transport Services)
description:
Job Description Operations Manager (Employee Transport Services) 
 Company Name: Traveltime Mobility India Private Limited
 Designation: Operations Manager Employee Transport Services (ETS)
 Job Location: Kharadi, Pune, Maharashtra
 Qualification: Graduate in any stream
 Experience: 5 To 10 years of experience in Employee Transportation Services (ETS)
 Age Criteria: 35 To 40 years 
 Role & responsibilities 1. Required Qualities and Competencies Strong Operational Knowledge: Sound knowledge of employee transportation operations, including employee pickup and drop services, fleet deployment, routing, scheduling, and trip management. Leadership Skills: Ability to lead, motivate, and manage operations teams, supervisors, and ground staff effectively. Proactive Approach: Ability to anticipate operational challenges and implement preventive measures to avoid service disruptions. Client Management: Strong communication and relationship-management skills to handle client officials, address concerns, and maintain client satisfaction. Service Delivery: Ability to fulfil client requirements and manage additional vehicle demands within committed timelines. Reliability and Integrity: High levels of accountability, transparency, professionalism, and ethical conduct. Flexibility: Willingness to work flexible hours, including shifts, weekends, and holidays, depending on operational requirements. Result-Oriented Mindset: Focus on achieving operational targets, improving service quality, controlling costs, and maintaining client satisfaction. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to make timely decisions and resolve critical operational issues under pressure. Coordination Skills: Effective coordination with clients, vendors, driver partners, supervisors, and the head office team. 2. Key Job Responsibilities A. Day-to-Day Operations Management Manage and monitor daily employee transportation operations at the Kharadi, Pune location. Ensure timely vehicle deployment for employee pickup and drop services. Monitor and achieve agreed operational performance targets, including OTA (On-Time Arrival) and OTD (On-Time Departure) . Ensure adequate fleet availability and efficient vehicle utilization. Handle last-minute vehicle shortages, breakdowns, driver absenteeism, route changes, and other operational emergencies. Implement effective contingency plans to ensure uninterrupted transportation services. B. Team Management and Leadership Lead and manage operations executives, supervisors, and ground-level teams. Allocate responsibilities, monitor individual performance, and ensure accountability. Conduct regular team briefings and review operational performance. Train and guide team members to improve productivity, discipline, and service quality. Maintain adequate manpower availability and ensure proper shift planning. C. Client Relationship Management Maintain professional and transparent communication with client officials. Attend client meetings and address operational concerns, complaints, and escalations. Ensure timely fulfilment of regular and additional vehicle requirements. Develop strong client relationships through consistent service delivery and proactive communication. Provide timely updates on operational challenges and corrective actions. D. Vendor and Driver Partner Management Develop and maintain a reliable network of vehicle vendors and driver partners. Identify and onboard suitable vendors to meet existing and future fleet requirements. Monitor vendor performance, vehicle availability, driver discipline, and service quality. Ensure compliance with client requirements and applicable transport regulations. Maintain backup vendors and vehicles to manage emergencies and sudden increases in demand. Build strong working relationships with driver partners to ensure operational stability. E. Business Development and Fleet Expansion Identify opportunities to expand existing business and improve client engagement. Support the procurement and onboarding of new clients. Assist in preparing operational proposals, fleet plans, and cost estimates. Coordinate with the management team to support business growth and improve profitability. Explore opportunities to optimize fleet utilization and reduce operational costs. F. Reporting and MIS Management Prepare and maintain daily and weekly operational reports. Review monthly MIS, trip data, vehicle utilization, attendance, and service performance. Coordinate with the billing team to ensure timely submission of trip data and closure of monthly billing. Monitor operational expenses, vendor costs, penalties, and other relevant cost parameters. Ensure accurate and timely sharing of reports with the head office and management. G. Compliance and Safety Ensure all deployed vehicles and drivers meet client-specific and applicable statutory compliance requirements. Monitor vehicle documents, driver licences, permits, insurance, fitness certificates, and other applicable records. Ensure adherence to client safety procedures and transportation policies. Coordinate with the compliance team for driver verification, training, and documentation. Ensure timely reporting, investigation, and closure of accidents, safety incidents, and compliance gaps. H. Coordination with Head Office Maintain transparent and timely communication with the head office team. Share operational updates, fleet requirements, client feedback, and critical escalations. Coordinate with finance, billing, compliance, HR, procurement, and other departments. Ensure management instructions and company policies are implemented effectively at the ground level. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The selected candidate will be evaluated against the following performance parameters: Achievement of agreed OTA and OTD targets. Vehicle availability and fulfilment of client requirements. Reduction in missed trips, delayed pickups, and operational complaints. Client satisfaction and effective closure of escalations. Vendor performance and driver partner retention. Timely submission of weekly reports and monthly MIS. Timely completion of monthly billing activities. Compliance adherence and safety performance. Effective cost control and fleet utilization. Team productivity, accountability, and operational stability. 
 4. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have substantial hands-on experience in employee transportation operations, a strong understanding of ground-level fleet management, and the ability to independently manage a client location. The candidate must be capable of leading a team, resolving operational challenges, managing vendors and drivers, handling client escalations, and ensuring consistent service delivery. 
 Preferred candidate profile : Candidates with experience managing large employee transport operations, corporate clients, multi-shift transportation, and high-volume fleet deployments in Pune will be given preference.

title: AI-First Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
About the Job 
 Job Title: AI-First Graphic Designer & Video Editor
 Location: Baner, Pune (Work from Office)
 Company: Yagy Tech Pvt. Ltd.
 Experience: 2 to 4 years
 Employment Type: Full-time, Monday to Saturday 
 About Yagy Tech 
 Yagy Tech builds and operates three brands across food and workplace dining. Mealawe offers home-style meals, DeskDyne helps companies manage workplace cafeterias, and Navmool offers organic food essentials such as ghee, oils, spices and grains. 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a creative professional who can design a static ad, edit a compelling video and use AI tools throughout production. You'll own design and video work for Yagy Tech and its three brands, from the first brief to the final export. Your work could range from a food Reel for Mealawe to a product walkthrough for DeskDyne or a packaging label for Navmool. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Branding & Graphic Design Maintain each brands visual identity across digital and print. Build reusable brand kits covering logos, colours, typography and templates. Design packaging, labels, product images and e-commerce listings for Navmool. Create pitch decks, brochures and case studies for DeskDyne, along with menus, in-app banners, offers and WhatsApp creatives for Mealawe. Support Yagy Techs hiring, events and internal communications with presentations, signage and print materials. 
 Advertising & Campaigns Create static ads, carousels and video ads for Meta, Google, YouTube and LinkedIn. Develop variations for A/B testing and use campaign results to improve the next set of creatives. Adapt campaign visuals for different placements, landing pages and app store listings. 
 Video Editing & Social Media Edit Reels, YouTube Shorts, product videos and long-form content. Handle cuts, pacing, captions, motion graphics, sound and colour correction. Turn customer, creator and influencer footage into ready-to-publish content. Design social posts, stories, carousels and thumbnails suited to each brands audience. 
 AI Tools & Creative Workflow Use AI for concept development, image and video generation, retouching, voiceovers and captions. Build reusable workflows for recurring tasks such as resizing ads, adapting layouts and captioning videos. Review and refine AI-generated material so that product details, visual quality and brand identity stay consistent. 

 Candidate Profile 
 Must-Have 
 2 to 4 years of professional experience in graphic design and video editing, gained at an agency, in-house or through freelance work. A portfolio showing both disciplines, including brand or advertising design, social content and video edits. Hands-on experience using AI in finished projects. You should be able to explain which tools you used, why you chose them and what you refined yourself. Expert in Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and After Effects (or DaVinci Resolve), along with Figma and Canva. Fluency with AI tools such as Magnific, Midjourney, Firefly, Ideogram or Flux for images,Runway, Kling, Veo or Sora for video, ElevenLabs for voice and ChatGPT or Claude for ideation and copy. Strong fundamentals in typography, layout, colour, composition, storytelling and pacing. 
 Good to Have 
 Experience working with food, FMCG or SaaS brands. Familiarity with packaging, print production, motion design or 2D/3D animation. Basic photography or videography skills for food and product shoots. Experience building repeatable AI workflows with tools such as Magnific, ComfyUI or Krea. 
 What Were Looking For 
 Someone who can switch between the visual styles of a consumer food brand and a B2B software platform while keeping each recognisable. The ability to manage briefs across brands, prioritise deadlines and take work from concept to delivery. Openness to feedback and the ability to use campaign results to explain what you would change in the next design or edit. 

 Note: Shortlisted candidates will get a short practical task (e.g. one ad static and one 30-second Reel for one of our brands), followed by an interview.

 About the Company Cordinet Technologies Private Limited is a product-focused technology company developing Intrix , a SaaS platform designed to simplify and streamline business operations. Intrix helps businesses manage customer relationships, field sales activities, product catalogues, sales orders, inventory, purchasing, order processing, dispatch operations, and third-party integrations through a connected platform. Our application is actively used by businesses to manage their daily operations. We are a focused engineering team that values practical problem-solving, clean code, technical ownership, and continuous improvement. 
 About the Role We are looking for a skilled and motivated PHP Laravel Developer to join our engineering team in Coimbatore. This is a hands-on development role focused on building, enhancing, and maintaining our existing Laravel-based SaaS platform. You will work directly with the lead developer to implement new features, develop backend APIs, optimize database operations, troubleshoot application issues, and improve existing business workflows. We are looking for someone who understands Laravel beyond basic CRUD operations and can confidently apply their technical knowledge to real-world business requirements. Strong fundamentals, genuine development experience, and independent problem-solving ability are more important to us than the number of years listed on a resume. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Backend Development PHP & Laravel Develop, enhance, and maintain backend modules using PHP and Laravel. Design and implement RESTful APIs for web and mobile applications. Implement business logic, request validation, authentication, and authorization. Work with Laravel controllers, service classes, middleware, models, and Eloquent ORM. Understand existing application architecture and extend functionality without disrupting current workflows. Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code. 
 2. MySQL & Database Management Design and maintain relational database tables, relationships, and migrations. Write efficient SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, filtering, grouping, and aggregation. Work with Eloquent relationships and Laravel Query Builder. Implement database transactions to maintain data integrity. Identify and resolve inefficient queries and database performance issues. Handle data validation and consistency across related business workflows. 
 3. Business Application Development Develop features for CRM, sales, order processing, inventory, purchasing, and dispatch management. Implement workflows involving multiple related database tables. Develop functionality involving status transitions, business validations, and transaction processing. Enhance existing product modules and implement new business requirements. Ensure application functionality remains reliable as new features are introduced. 
 4. Debugging, Testing & Maintenance Investigate and resolve Laravel application bugs, API failures, and database issues. Analyze application logs, exceptions, and error reports. Identify root causes and implement reliable solutions. Test new features and verify existing functionality after changes. Improve code quality, performance, and maintainability. 
 5. Integrations & Collaboration Develop and maintain integrations with third-party REST APIs. Work with JSON, HTTP requests, responses, and API authentication. Use Git for version control and collaborative development. Coordinate directly with the lead developer on technical requirements and implementation. Communicate development progress, technical challenges, and solutions clearly. 
 Required Technical Skills PHP & Laravel Strong understanding of PHP fundamentals and object-oriented programming. Hands-on professional experience with the Laravel framework. Laravel routing, controllers, middleware, and request validation. Eloquent ORM, model relationships, and Query Builder. Database migrations and application configuration. REST API development and integration. Authentication and authorization fundamentals. Exception handling, logging, and debugging. 
 MySQL & Database Development Strong understanding of relational database concepts. Experience with SQL joins, subqueries, and database relationships. Knowledge of database indexing and query optimization fundamentals. Understanding of database transactions and data integrity. Ability to work with complex, interconnected database structures. 
 Other Essential Skills Git and version-control workflows. JSON and HTTP request/response handling. Basic JavaScript and AJAX. Ability to understand, debug, and modify an existing codebase. Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently implement assigned development tasks.
